  • You want to work in a startup environment that values excellence, autonomy, and ownership.

  • You are fluent in English with strong communication skills.

  • You are based in Paris, or live in Paris timezone

Why join us

  • International mindset: We have offices in Paris and New York.

  • On-site or full remote: On-site job in Paris (2-3 days in office), or full remote position on Paris timezone (1 monthly visit in our Paris office).

  • Exciting moment: Opportunity to contribute to the Engineering function in the AI era.

  • All-star team: Extremely solid team with deep functional and domain expertise.

  • Learning opportunity: Strong focus on learning and growing through education and professional development.

  • Offsites: Regular offsites with the team, meetups, and strong connections to the startup ecosystem.

Recruitment Process

1 - Screening call

It’s a discussion with your future manager. We’ll get deeper into your expertise and know-how. We’ll also give you a clearer view of what your day-to-day in that role is like. It’s a good opportunity to see if you foresee yourself working at Upflow.

2 - Take home assignment

It’s a coding exercise that can only be completed successfully with the help of AI. In addition to delivering working software that meets the requirements, you’ll be evaluated on your product and architectural decisions.

3 - Technical interview

In this interview, we’ll review your take-home assignment and discuss how you approach designing scalable systems and making architectural decisions.

4 - Meet the team!

You’ll also meet up with at least two other peers so you can foresee yourself as part of this team.

5 - Founder interview

Meet with Alex (co-founder & CEO). He will tell you everything about Upflow’s vision and values. It’s a privileged moment to ask questions, too.

6 - Alignment and offer

If the team meetings go well on both sides, we’ll invite you to this final step. Getting here means we both see a strong fit and believe Upflow is a place where you can grow and shine over the next few years. We’ll align on how you’ll join us (role scope, start date, package), and if we’re all on the same page, we’ll extend you an offer!

 

*****

Diversity & Inclusion

At Upflow, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage all individuals to apply, even if you don’t meet every qualification. Research shows that some candidates may hesitate to apply unless they meet every requirement. However, we believe that a variety of experiences and perspectives can bring value beyond the listed qualifications. title: GTM Enablement - Partner Program
description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

As a Partner Enablement Program Manager, you'll build and run the ElevenLabs partner academy for systems integrators, hyperscalers and technology partners. You'll create curricula across sales, pre-sales and technical implementation, starting with ElevenAgents and expanding across ElevenCreative and ElevenAPI. You'll work closely with our regional Forward Deployed Engineers, who bring the technical expertise and set the technical quality bar. Your mission is to grow the program to 10,000+ certified partner professionals by the end of 2027, and to make the ElevenLabs certification a credential the tech ecosystem respects.

As a Partner Enablement Program Manager, you can expect to:

  • Build curricula for partner sellers, pre-sales and implementation engineers: courses, hands-on labs and assessments.

  • Turn expert knowledge from our FDEs, sales and product teams into a world-class online academy.

  • Run the certification program end to end, from submissions and review workflows to certificates, with FDEs making the technical call.

  • Scale the program through automation, from automated agent review to bots and emails that support learners.

  • Deliver training online and in person, including sales and technical sessions at our partner hackathons.

  • Run program administration: the learning platform, partner onboarding tracks, reporting and learner feedback.

Requirements

We're looking for an enablement builder who is comfortable with both commercial and technical topics. You don't need to be the deepest expert in the room, but you need enough depth to work with senior engineers and sellers as subject matter experts and turn their knowledge into great learning. You'll thrive with us if you:

  • Are passionate about AI, technology and ElevenLabs products.

  • Have built enablement or training programs at scale for partners, sellers or technical teams.

  • Learn technical products quickly and can explain them to both technical and commercial audiences.

  • Can run a program end to end: learning platforms, timelines, stakeholders and reporting.

  • Can lead a session or workshop in front of sellers and engineers.

  • Have strong instructional design skills: you can turn expert content into clear courses, labs and assessments.

  • Enjoy turning repeat work into automations, tools and agents.

  • Have excellent communication skills and can adapt your message to different audiences.

Bonus:

  • Experience as a forward deployed engineer, solutions engineer or in professional services for a frontier AI product.

  • Hands-on experience building LLM applications or voice and chat agents, and reviewing whether they are ready for production.

  • Familiarity with Python or TypeScript, APIs, webhooks and common integration patterns.

  • Telephony experience, such as SIP, Twilio or contact center platforms.

  • Experience at a systems integrator, hyperscaler or technology partner.

  • Experience with learning platforms such as WorkRamp.

  • Proficient in Spanish or Portuguese.

Growth Potential

We believe in hiring the best talent in the world to make an impact in the right role at the right time. At ElevenLabs, strong performance creates opportunities for growth. Here are some of the career paths you can expect after excelling in this role:

  • Leading a partner enablement team as the academy grows.

  • Moving into partner program leadership or Solutions Engineering.

Location

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in North America, with the ability to operate in Americas timezones required. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in New York or San Francisco.

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

title: Staff Application Security Engineer
description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara sits at the center of hardware, software, AI, and the physical world, processing 25+ trillion data points annually across thousands of connected devices. The Samsara Application Security team protects this vast footprint end-to-end, spanning cloud services, internal systems, and firmware running on IoT hardware in the field.

As a Staff Application Security Engineer, you'll drive the overarching technical direction for our application security and vulnerability management programs. This is a high-visibility role where you'll influence a broad surface area while retaining the flexibility to dive deep into critical domain focus areas as security priorities evolve.

This is a remote position, open to candidates residing in the UK. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

You should apply if: 

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, and countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper-growth environment.
  • You're energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-caliber team that will encourage you to do your best.

In this role, you will: 

  • Lead the ongoing strategy, operation, and continuous improvement of Samsara's vulnerability management program, along with other core application security programs — not just execute against an existing process, but define what the process should be.
  • Own and drive down mean time to remediate (MTTR) across the vulnerability backlog, as SLAs tighten.
  • Build and champion automation and tooling that scale vulnerability detection and response across cloud, firmware/IoT, and corporate systems, rather than relying on manual, one-by-one review.
  • Set technical and architectural direction for the program, translating leadership's strategic priorities into a concrete execution plan for the team.
  • Drive remediation by building trust with engineering teams and providing clear, actionable guidance — partnering with technical program management on reporting rather than owning it directly.
  • Mentor and level up other engineers on secure design and remediation practices, and be a technical voice other teams look to when priorities are unclear.
  • Communicate risk and remediation tradeoffs to engineering leadership in terms they can act on, without owning the relationship end to end.
  • Participate in security incident investigations involving high-profile vulnerabilities, assessing potential impact on Samsara's infrastructure.
  • Be regularly on call to support critical vulnerability response.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 10+ years of relevant experience as a cloud engineer or security engineer, including hands-on vulnerability management across a broad, multi-product enterprise environment  — not a single product or team's slice of it.
  • Proficiency in Go, Python, and JavaScript.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently set technical and architectural direction for a security program, and to drive remediation across a broad, multi-surface environment without direct authority over the teams doing the fixing.
  • Significant experience with modern vulnerability management tooling (e.g., Wiz, Semgrep) and deep familiarity with vulnerability scoring frameworks such as CVSS and EPSS.
  • Strong AWS cloud services background.
  • Deep understanding of Static Application Security Testing (SAST), Dynamic Application Security Testing (DAST), and Software Composition Analysis (SCA).
  • Hands-on use of AI/LLM tooling in your own security workflow — triage, detection logic, remediation drafting — plus credibility speaking to how AI is changing the threat landscape and the tooling available to address it.
  • Location: must be based in central or eastern timezones.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience with C/C++, relevant to firmware and embedded systems.
  • Background at a cloud-native, AI-forward company actively building agentic or AI-driven products.
  • Experience with security automation platforms (e.g., Tines) and serverless frameworks (e.g., AWS Lambda).
  • Experience integrating vulnerability management into modern CI/CD pipelines with a "shift-left" mentality.
  • Experience spanning SaaS, firmware, and corporate IT security programs — not just one product line.
  • Experience managing vulnerabilities within a FedRAMP-certified environment.
  • Experience building, extending, or wiring up AI copilots/agents for security workflows (e.g., automated triage, remediation drafting).

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in ----- ----- or ----- For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

title: Senior Sales Engineer, France
description:
Get to Know Us

Horizon3 is a fast-growing, remote cybersecurity company dedicated to the mission of enabling organizations to proactively find and fix and verify exploitable attack vectors before criminals exploit them. Our flagship product, the NodeZeroTM platform, delivers production-safe autonomous pentests and other key assessment operations that scale across the largest internal, external, cloud, and hybrid cloud environments. NodeZero has been adopted by organizations of all sizes, from small educational institutions to government agencies and Global 100 enterprises. It is used by ITOps/SecOps teams, consulting pentesters, and MSSPs and MSPs. 

We are a fusion of former U.S. Special Operations cyber operators, startup engineers, and formerly frustrated cybersecurity practitioners. We're committed to helping solve our common security problems: ineffective security tools, false positives resulting in alert fatigue, blind spots, "checkbox” security culture, cybersecurity skills shortage, and the long lead time and expense of hiring outside consultants. Collectively, we are a team of learn it alls, committed to a culture of respect, collaboration, ownership, and results.

What You’ll Do

Horizon3 is committed to defending businesses from the ever-growing threat landscape. Our advanced solutions and expert team provide unparalleled security for our clients. We are looking for a passionate Sales Engineer/Solutions Architect to join our team and help prospects and clients understand the true value and capabilities of our products and services.

  • Technical expertise - Demonstrate deep knowledge of our cybersecurity products and services, assisting the sales team in presenting and position them to prospects and clients

  • Customer engagement - Meet with potential customers to understand their cybersecurity needs, challenges, and infrastructure, ensuring that our solutions are the perfect fit for them

  • Product demonstrations - Provide live demos and proof of concepts for our cybersecurity solutions, tailoring each demo to the specific needs and concerns of the potential customer

  • Solution development - Will work closely with the sales and product teams to design and refine our solutions based on customer needs

  • Technical training - train the sales team on the technical aspects of our products to enhance their ability to sell more effectively

  • Feedback loop - relay feedback from the field to our product and engineering teams, contributing to the ongoing improvement of our product

  • RFP/RFI assistance - Assist in answering technical sections of RFPs and RFIs

  • Post-sales support - On rare occasions, assist in post-sales processes to ensure the smooth implementation and satisfaction of our customers

What You’ll Bring

  • 5+ years of experience as a Pre-Sales Engineer/Solutions Architect in the cybersecurity domain

  • Strong understanding of cyber threats, risk management, and cybersecurity solutions.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills

  • Demonstrated ability to simplify complex technical topics for a non-technical audience

  • Highly collaborative with a strong sense of initiative

Artificial Intelligence. Actual Impact.

At Docebo, we’re using AI to change how people learn at work—and we mean actually change it. We’re an AI-powered learning platform that helps organizations create, deliver, and manage training all in one place. But our real mission goes deeper: we help teams move faster, work smarter, and focus on the work that truly matters. Our platform is built with intelligent, time-saving tools that personalize learning, eliminate busywork, and turn training from a checkbox into a superpower. The result? Better experiences for learners and real results for businesses.

We’re shaping the future of learning with a team that isn’t afraid to challenge the status quo. If you're excited by the idea of using AI to make work-life better for real people–you’ll feel right at home here. And it’s not just what we build, it’s how we show up. At Docebo, our values aren’t just posters on the wall—they guide how we work every day. We call it the Docebo Heart: trust by default, assume positive intent, and create space for different perspectives to thrive.

So… what are you waiting for? Join 900+ Docebians around the world and help us reinvent the way people learn, because learning never stops.

🚀 The Adventure Ahead

As a Technical Account Manager, you’re the trusted technical engine behind our enterprise customers' greatest learning transformations! You will embed yourself as an essential strategic partner, bridging high-level customer business goals with Docebo’s cutting-edge platform capabilities. In this role, you won't just solve problems—you'll architect long-term technical strategies, pilot innovative solutions, and ensure our customers unlock maximum value to become partners for life.

This is a fully remote position, open to candidates located in Germany.

⚡ The Day-to-Day

  • Architect the Future: Translate customer business and eLearning goals into long-term, scalable technical strategies using Docebo’s robust feature set.

  • Own the Technical Relationship: Take full technical and product ownership of your assigned enterprise accounts while collaborating closely with Account Teams on commercial growth.

  • Serve as the Trusted Advisor: Guide executive and technical stakeholders through platform innovations, API integrations, and AI-assisted workflows to maximize operational efficiency.

  • Proactively Protect Platform Health: Monitor technical performance metrics—like API usage and login trends—to catch and mitigate potential risks long before they hit platform stability.

  • Lead Executive Technical Reviews: Deliver high-impact performance presentations on SLAs directly to customer leadership and champion customer feedback internally to Docebo teams.

  • Drive Systemic Platform Improvements: Partner with Premium Advisors and internal resources to analyze support case patterns, run proof-of-concept pilot projects, and streamline overall platform health.

💪 Your Superpowers

  • Family First: We provide coverage offering you time with your little one(s) so you can soak up all those precious moments. Fun fact: we had 30 Docebian babies join the family in 2025!

  • Connections That Count: Connect with global communities through our Employee Resource Groups (including PRIDE, DWA, BIDOC, and Green Ambassadors) and company-wide events that keep the fun rolling all year long.

About Docebo 💙

At Docebo, we create seamless, AI-powered learning experiences for over 3,000 customers worldwide. We have successfully achieved two IPOs (TSX: DCBO & NASDAQ: DCBO), been recognized as a top SaaS e-learning solution, and are growing exponentially in the process. Our team is guided by five core values—Grow Together Win Together, Build with Our Customer, Clear is Kind, Own Outcomes, Progress Over Perfection—that shape everything we do. description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We’re looking for an iOS Engineer to join our growing mobile team and build the Creative App (iOS), bringing our audio AI to millions of users. You’ll ship features that integrate tightly with our AI-driven audio models, and work out where focused bets or incremental improvements will move the product most.

You’re impact-driven and autonomous, and good at drawing clear conclusions from experimental results. You’ll work closely with design, product and research, and help shape the app’s architecture and technical direction.

Requirements

  • Strong native iOS development (Swift, SwiftUI) with a track record of shipping features that improved engagement

  • Have designed and run A/B tests, using data to decide what to build next

  • Comfortable with ambiguity and fast-changing priorities, and able to add structure where it’s needed

  • Experience owning performance, quality and responsiveness in a production app

Bonus

  • Experience with audio playback or streaming on iOS

  • Experience building mobile infrastructure for build, test and release pipelines

Location

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere, with the ability to operate in GMT to GMT+4 timezones preferred. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, Warsaw, Dublin, Amsterdam and Paris.

#LI-Remote

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

title: Engineering Manager (w/m/d) Robotics Tooling
description:
Deine Aufgaben

Du arbeitest in einem Team, das das gesamte Tooling-Ökosystem verantwortet, mit dem unsere Jungheinrich Robotics Lösungen über ihren gesamten Lebenszyklus hinweg implementiert, betrieben, unterstützt und kontinuierlich verbessert werden. Von der Inbetriebnahme eines Fahrzeugs vor Ort bis hin zur Ferndiagnose von Problemen einer gesamten Flotte stellst du gemeinsam mit deinem Team sicher, dass unsere Robotiksysteme über alle Robotikprodukte und zukünftigen Fahrzeuggenerationen hinweg effizient und skalierbar ausgeliefert, betrieben und unterstützt werden können.

Du arbeitest dabei in drei zentralen Bereichen:

  • Du entwickelst unser Onsite Tooling weiter und ermöglichst damit eine effiziente Implementierung, Inbetriebnahme und Durchführung von Serviceaktivitäten über unser HMI und unseren Environment Editor.
  • Du entwickelst unser Remote Tooling als Teil unserer Robotics Cloud weiter und ermöglichst damit Diagnose, Flottenmanagement, Monitoring und Support aus der Ferne.
  • Du gestaltest unsere Remote-Access-Lösungen und stellst einen sicheren und skalierbaren Zugriff auf unsere Robotiksysteme sicher, wann immer dieser erforderlich ist.

Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Product Manager für Robotics Tooling zusammen. Während der Product Manager den Fokus stärker auf das Was und Warum legt, ergänzt du diese Perspektive um das Wie und Wann.

  • Du verantwortest die technische Ausrichtung unseres Toolings, das eine schnelle Implementierung, effiziente Serviceprozesse, den Flottenbetrieb, Ferndiagnosen und eine hohe Systemverfügbarkeit ermöglicht
  • Du gestaltest ein skalierbares Tooling-Ökosystem, das über verschiedene Roboterfamilien, Kundeninstallationen und Supportorganisationen hinweg eingesetzt werden kann
  • Du führst und entwickelst ein Team aus internen und externen Software Engineers und schaffst ein Umfeld, in dem sich Mitarbeitende weiterentwickeln, erfolgreich arbeiten und wirkungsvolle Lösungen liefern können
  • Du definierst, steuerst und verfolgst gemeinsam mit dem Product Manager die vereinbarte Roadmap und stellst deren erfolgreiche Umsetzung sicher
  • Du baust starke Partnerschaften mit Product Management, Vehicle Engineering, Service, Operations und IT auf, um ein integriertes Tooling-Ökosystem zu realisieren
  • Du verbesserst kontinuierlich die User Experience für Inbetriebnahme- und Servicetechniker:innen, Supportteams und unsere Kunden
  • Du gestaltest die Strategie und Umsetzung sicherer Remote-Access-Lösungen und bringst dabei betriebliche Effizienz, Sicherheitsanforderungen und Kundenbedürfnisse in Einklang
  • Du förderst die Weiterentwicklung und Leistungsfähigkeit deines Teams durch Engagement, Coaching, individuelle Entwicklung und kontinuierliche Verbesserung
  • Du treibst Engineering Excellence durch agile Arbeitsweisen, qualitativ hochwertige Softwareentwicklung und moderne Engineering-Standards voran

Dein Profil

  • Du bringst fundierte Erfahrung in der Führung von Software-Engineering-Teams in agilen Produktentwicklungsumgebungen mit.
  • Du verfügst über einen starken Software-Engineering-Hintergrund und praktische technische Erfahrung.
  • Du bringst Erfahrung im Coaching von Engineers mit und unterstützt sie aktiv in ihrer fachlichen und persönlichen Weiterentwicklung.
  • Du bringst Erfahrung in den Bereichen Robotik, Automatisierung, Embedded Systems oder vergleichbaren technischen Bereichen mit.
  • Du hast Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von Frontend-Anwendungen und nutzerorientierter Software.
  • Du kommunizierst klar und wirkungsvoll und bringst unterschiedliche Stakeholder auf gemeinsame Ziele zusammen.
  • Du begeisterst dich dafür, reale Herausforderungen mithilfe von Technologie zu lösen.
  • Du arbeitest überwiegend vor Ort, weshalb du idealerweise in München oder der näheren Umgebung wohnst.
  • Das ist ein Plus:
    • Du bringst Erfahrung mit Human-Machine Interfaces (HMI) mit.
    • Du kennst die Abläufe rund um die Implementierung, den Service oder den Betrieb von Robotern.
    • Du bringst Erfahrung mit Monitoring-, Observability- oder Remote-Diagnostics-Lösungen mit.
    • Du kennst dich mit Networking, Infrastruktur, Security oder Remote-Access-Konzepten aus.
    • Du bringst Erfahrung in der engen Zusammenarbeit mit Kunden oder operativen Teams im Feld mit.

Was wir bieten

  • Spitzentechnologie: Als Pioniere der Robotik sind wir in der Lage, ohne Schienen und Leitlinien zu navigieren und zu manipulieren, und bieten Lösungen für Prozesse, die noch nie jemand zuvor automatisieren konnte!
  • Team: Wir sind ein internationales Team mit mehr als 25 Nationalitäten. Du wirst in einem Team mit sehr smarten, bescheidenen, kooperativen und fleißigen Menschen arbeiten.
  • Kultur: Sei einfach Du selbst! Werde Teil eines dynamischen, innovativenund vielfältigen Teams, das Zusammenarbeit über Hierarchie stellt. Um innovativ zu sein, muss man ab und zu scheitern – wir lernen und verbessern uns ständig.
  • Arbeitsplatz: Unser Büro befindet sich in der Nähe der S‑Bahn-Station „Hirschgarten“. Wir arbeiten in einem Büro im Loft-Stil mit toller Ausstattung, eigener Werkstatt und Testbereich.
  • Vollverpflegung: Du hast keine Lust, darüber nachzudenken, was du morgen zu Mittag essen willst, geschweige denn, es vorzubereiten? Zum Glück verwöhnt uns unser französischer Koch jeden Tag mit einem frisch gekochten kostenlosen Mittagessen! Und als Sahnehäubchen gibt es einen gefüllten Kühlschrank mit Getränken, frischem Obst und natürlich Kaffee!
  • Flexibilitä t: Flexibilität wird bei uns großgeschrieben. Unser hybrides Arbeitsmodell für Positionen, bei denen Anwesenheit verzichtbar ist, trägt zu einer gesunden Work-Life-Balance bei.
  • Benefits: Wir bieten attraktive Urlaubs‑, Wellpass‑,Gesundheits- und Vergütungsleistungen. Erfahre hier mehr über unsere aktuellen Benefits.

Du erfüllst nicht alle Anforderungen zu 100 %? Kein Problem. Wir wissen, dass die besten Talente nicht immer jeden Punkt einer Stellenanzeige mitbringen. Wenn Du Dich für Robotik begeisterst und die Zukunft der Automatisierung mitgestalten möchtest, freuen wir uns auf Deine Bewerbung. Vielleicht ist genau diese Position der richtige nächste Schritt für Dich oder eine andere spannende Gelegenheit bei Jungheinrich Robotics.

Für uns bei Jungheinrich Robotics ist die Förderung der Inklusion sehr wichtig. Wir sind daher bestrebt, ein inklusives Umfeld für alle Kandidaten zu schaffen und bieten allen qualifizierten Bewerbern unabhängig von Geschlecht, ethnischer Zugehörigkeit, Alter, nationaler Herkunft, sexueller Orientierung, Kultur oder Bildung gleiche Chancen. Wenn Du gewisse Anpassungen benötigst, um den Rekruitingprozess für Dich zugänglich zu machen, werden wir unser Bestes tun, um Dir entgegenzukommen. Sprich uns gerne darauf an!

title: Senior/Lead Machine Learning Engineer
description:
What we are building

Mimica is an AI-powered process intelligence platform enabling enterprises and individuals to reclaim their most precious resource: time. We've all seen repetitive tasks and redundant processes quietly drain productivity and creativity. Not because companies don’t want to become more efficient, but because they don’t know where to start.

Mimica automatically analyzes your team’s work, then generates the AI agents to execute it. Our software turns everyday work into data-backed decisions, helping companies remove process bottlenecks, automate the right tasks, and upskill teams with precision and confidence.

We’ve raised $26 million in Series B financing and are scaling fast. Backed by investors including Khosla Ventures and Paladin Capital, our proprietary AI technology is trusted by Fortune 500 companies to accelerate transformation. Mimica is recognized as a Top 100 AI Start-up by Accel and an industry Leader by the Everest Group.

Our team

Behind our platform is a team of exceptionally talented people, remote-first and globally distributed across 16+ countries. We're looking for curious, collaborative people excited to solve complex problems. You'll join a fast-paced environment built on high ownership, bottom-up thinking, and transparent, open communication – helping some of the world's leading organizations transform the way work gets done with AI.

Our approach to engineering

  • We prioritize customer needs first

  • We work in small, project-based teams

  • We have flexibility in terms of the problems we work on

  • We own the full lifecycle of our projects

  • We avoid silos and encourage taking up tasks in new areas

  • We balance quality and velocity

  • We have a shared responsibility for our production code

  • We each set our own routine to maximize our productivity

 

Your mission

 

You’ll join us as a Machine Learning Engineer/ Data Scientist for Mimica’s Data Intelligence team, whose goal is to transform raw recorded data into clean, structured, anonymized data that powers the work of other teams.

You’ll own key parts of our ML pipelines end to end, making them more accurate, cost-efficient, and trustworthy. Along the way, you’ll build evaluations and LLM judges, run experiments, and transform promising results into validated production improvements.

Your work will be applied and LLM-heavy, with opportunities to evaluate and fine-tune open-source models and build smaller, task-specific models.

If you enjoy taking ML beyond experiments, this is your chance to shape the systems at the heart of Mimica’s products and see your work deliver value to real users at scale.

 

Part of your day-to-day

 

  • Own, debug, and improve production pipelines for accuracy and efficiency.

  • Design, build, and iterate on LLM evals and LLM-as-a-judge systems, including the datasets, metrics, and benchmarks to monitor quality.

  • Run rigorous experiments on prompts, pipeline design, model choice, and inputs (e.g., OCR text vs. image + OCR), and turn the results into clear recommendations.

  • Drive LLM efficiency improvements across our pipelines by comparing models, restructuring steps, and replacing LLM calls with smaller, purpose-built models where it makes sense.

  • Expand our anonymization pipeline, including evaluating and adapting existing models.

  • Work with Python and quality engineers to take experiments into production, and share responsibility for the code you ship.

  • Document findings in writing (eg. experiment reports, design docs)

 

What we’re looking for

 

Primarily, we’re looking for an individual with an experiment- and data-driven researcher mindset with good coding habits. This includes:

  • Solid machine learning/data science background: you understand experimental design, data splits, metrics, bias, and statistical significance, and you know when a result is real.

  • Hands-on experience applying LLMs in production or near-production settings, especially evaluating them: building eval sets, LLM judges and benchmarks, and iterating on prompts and pipelines against them.

  • Comfortable getting deep into messy data: exploring it, troubleshooting issues, and transforming insights into measurable improvements.

  • Strong Python and good engineering skills. You write clear, readable, tested code that others can take to production, even if you’re not the one owning the infrastructure.

  • Able to work independently on ambiguous problems: framing the question, choosing the approach, and deciding on the acceptance criteria to ship.

  • Use AI coding tools effectively and stay accountable for the output: understand, explain, and defend everything you ship.

  • Communicate clearly in spoken and written English, including explaining technical trade-offs to both technical and non-technical audiences

 

Bonus / Nice to have

  • Experience with classical ML or deep learning model development.

  • Experience with image/OCR pipelines or face-related anonymization

  • Experience shipping end-to-end ML features in a startup or scale-up environment.

This is a fully remote position. To make sure we work well together, we’re only considering candidates based in the UK or Europe, in time zones compatible with London (typically UTC-1 to UTC+3).

title: SEO & Digital Marketing Specialist
description:
SEO & Digital Marketing Specialist – Technical SEO, Google Ads & Lead Generation | Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours
Experience Level: Mid-Level to Senior
Department: Digital Marketing / Growth Marketing

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring an experienced SEO & Digital Marketing Specialist to develop, execute, and optimize digital marketing strategies that increase organic traffic, improve search rankings, generate qualified leads, and drive measurable business growth.

The ideal candidate has strong expertise in technical SEO, Google Ads, paid social advertising, content optimization, marketing analytics, and automation. This is a hands-on role requiring someone who can independently manage campaigns, identify growth opportunities, and turn marketing data into actionable strategies.

You’ll take ownership of organic search performance, paid advertising, website optimization, and lead generation while exploring emerging opportunities in AI-powered search optimization (AEO/GEO).

Key Responsibilities

SEO Strategy & Optimization

  • Develop and execute SEO strategies to improve organic visibility, keyword rankings, and website traffic.
  • Conduct keyword research, competitor analysis, and search intent analysis.
  • Perform technical SEO audits, addressing indexing, crawling, site architecture, page speed, and mobile performance.
  • Optimize meta titles, descriptions, headings, internal linking, URLs, and structured data.
  • Execute ethical link-building strategies and monitor search algorithm updates.
  • Optimize content for traditional search engines and AI-powered search experiences (AEO/GEO).

Paid Advertising & Lead Generation

  • Plan, launch, and optimize campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads, and LinkedIn Ads.
  • Manage advertising budgets to improve lead quality, Cost per Lead (CPL), and Return on Ad Spend (ROAS).
  • Develop and optimize landing pages, lead capture forms, and conversion funnels.
  • Implement retargeting and remarketing campaigns.
  • Collaborate with sales teams to align marketing initiatives with revenue goals.

Content Marketing & Website Management

  • Develop SEO-driven content strategies aligned with business objectives.
  • Create and optimize website copy, blog articles, and landing pages.
  • Manage website updates through WordPress, Webflow, or similar CMS platforms.
  • Collaborate with designers, developers, and content creators to improve website performance and user experience.

Analytics, Reporting & Optimization

  • Monitor traffic, keyword rankings, conversions, and campaign performance using Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Search Console, and Google Tag Manager.
  • Build performance dashboards and provide actionable marketing reports.
  • Conduct A/B testing across landing pages, advertisements, and campaigns.
  • Analyze user behavior and identify opportunities to improve conversion rates.

Marketing Automation & CRM

  • Manage email marketing campaigns, lead nurturing sequences, and automated workflows.
  • Work with platforms such as HubSpot, GoHighLevel, Salesforce, or ActiveCampaign.
  • Improve lead tracking, marketing attribution, and sales handoffs.
  • Maintain accurate campaign data and performance reporting.

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years of professional experience in SEO, digital marketing, or performance marketing.
  • Proven success improving organic rankings, website traffic, and qualified lead generation.
  • Strong knowledge of technical SEO, on-page SEO, off-page SEO, and content optimization.
  • Hands-on experience with GA4, Google Search Console, Google Tag Manager, SEMrush, Ahrefs, or similar tools.
  • Experience managing Google Ads and paid social media campaigns.
  • Familiarity with WordPress, Webflow, or other CMS platforms.
  • Understanding of conversion rate optimization (CRO), landing pages, and lead generation funnels.
  • Experience with CRM and marketing automation platforms.
  • Strong analytical skills and ability to translate data into actionable improvements.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Ability to independently manage multiple campaigns and meet deadlines.
  • Availability during U.S. Business Hours.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO).
  • Knowledge of local SEO and Google Business Profile optimization.
  • Familiarity with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and technical website improvements.
  • Experience in B2B marketing, SaaS, professional services, or lead-generation businesses.
  • Experience with Looker Studio and advanced marketing reporting.
  • Certifications in Google Ads, Google Analytics, HubSpot, or SEO.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You take ownership of marketing performance and focus on measurable results.
  • You understand how SEO, paid advertising, content, and conversion optimization work together.
  • You can independently develop strategies, execute campaigns, and analyze performance.
  • You’re proactive about identifying growth opportunities and testing improvements.
  • You stay informed about search engine updates and emerging AI-powered marketing trends.
  • You communicate clearly and collaborate effectively with remote teams.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

Your day may begin by reviewing GA4, Google Search Console, and advertising dashboards to evaluate traffic, keyword rankings, and lead generation performance. You’ll investigate SEO opportunities, optimize paid campaigns, update website content, or improve landing page conversions.

You may also configure marketing automation workflows, analyze campaign results, and collaborate with sales or development teams to implement improvements.

In short: You’ll manage SEO, paid advertising, analytics, and marketing automation to generate qualified leads and drive measurable business growth.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Success in this role will be measured through:

  • Organic Traffic Growth: Increase qualified organic website traffic.
  • Keyword Rankings: Improve rankings for high-intent commercial keywords.
  • Lead Generation: Increase marketing-qualified leads from organic and paid channels.
  • Conversion Rate: Improve website and landing page conversions.
  • Cost per Lead (CPL): Optimize advertising spend and acquisition efficiency.
  • Return on Ad Spend (ROAS): Improve paid campaign profitability.
  • Technical SEO Health: Maintain indexing, crawling, and website performance.
  • Marketing Attribution: Ensure accurate tracking of leads, conversions, and campaign results.

Interview Process

  1. Initial Application
  2. Spark Hire One-Way Video Interview
  3. Recruiter Screening
  4. Client Interview
  5. Final Selection & Onboarding

Spark Hire Video Interview – Required

As part of the application process, all candidates are required to complete a one-way video interview through Spark Hire.

After completing the first step of your application, you’ll receive a Spark Hire invitation by email with instructions to record and submit your video responses.

Completion of the Spark Hire video is required to be considered for the next stage. Please check your inbox as well as your spam or junk folder for the invitation.

title: Senior Product Engineer
description:
About Kernel

Agents are starting to sell, buy and operate on behalf of companies. But before an agent can close a deal, qualify an account, route a lead or assess risk, it has to answer a basic question: which company is this?

 

Today, that answer is messy, and no one answers it reliably. Business identity lives across CRMs, ERPs and third-party datasets full of duplicates, missing parent companies, stale addresses and incorrect enrichment. The cost shows up across the enterprise: sales teams miss revenue opportunities because they lack the right account context; operations teams take on avoidable exposure because risk signals are fragmented or wrong; and finance teams end up chasing, writing off, or defaulting on bad debt that should have been caught earlier.

 

Humans have worked around that mess for years. Agents cannot. They need a reliable business identity layer they can trust.

 

Kernel is building that layer: the business registry for agents. We issue a permanent KERN ID for every business, plus the context an agent needs to act on it. Ops, data and revenue teams at Gong, Legora, Mistral, Canva and Checkout already use Kernel on their own systems. Agents are next, and there will be far more of them.

 

We have raised $20M from top VCs and operators at Plaid, OpenAI, Slack and others, and we are growing 5x YoY.

The Role

You are a T-shaped product engineer with a spike in backend engineering. You will work closely with the product and engineering team to build user-facing features, ship at pace, and support the existing infrastructure as we scale. You do not need to be a DevOps expert, but familiarity with AWS and Kubernetes is valuable.

You take initiative, adapt quickly, and communicate clearly. The team is small and fast-moving, so you’ll be expected to make decisions and ship code autonomously. You will help the company grow from $3M to $30M ARR, owning projects end-to-end—from ideation to deployment—while helping shape how we build products and infrastructure at Kernel.

What You’ll Be Doing

What You Bring

If you're new to LLMs but have shipped complex production systems in other domains and are comfortable rapidly learning new technologies, we'd still love to hear from you.

  • Ability to operate autonomously in a small, high-velocity team

  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills

  • Some experience with Kubernetes or distributed systems

It is a plus if you also have:

  • Experience working on AI-driven or data-heavy products

  • Frontend experience (NextJS, React, TypeScript)

  • Understanding of CRM data models or workflow automation

⚠️ This role may not be for you if you:

  • Need lots of structure or long-term roadmaps

  • Prefer perfect specs before building

  • Focus narrowly on backend or frontend only

❌ This role is definitely not for you if you:

  • Prefer fully remote work (this role requires at least 3 days a week in the office)

What We Offer

title: Frontend Engineer
description:
About Shiftbase

We build workforce software that helps people get work done. More than 10,000 companies use our platform every month to plan shifts and track time, with less admin in the way.

We work from our Zoetermeer office with over 80 people and we grow every year. The culture is open and informal. You can push back on an idea regardless of title, and we change how we work when someone makes the case in retro.

About the role

You build frontend features that customers use the day you release them. You sit in a product team with backend, QA, design and product, and you take a feature from a rough product idea to a screen a planner can use without a manual.

Your time is a balance between working on features, bugs and resolving technical debt.

Claude Code is how our engineers write software. Everyone here uses it daily, and whole features now go out with an agent doing most of the coding. You still own what you merge, so you read the diff, you know why it works, and you can defend it in review. The interesting part of the job is deciding what to hand to an agent, what to write yourself, and what context the agent needs to get it right the first time.

You ask what a planner is trying to do before you read what the ticket says. You automate the parts of your own process that don't need a human.

Year one, in order

First, ship. Deliver features in scheduling and time tracking. Start small, then take one full feature from the product conversation through to release.

Then, own an area. Pick up a product surface end to end and become the person the team asks about it, including what it should do next. That covers how AI fits your area, which patterns you document for the agent and which calls you keep for yourself.

Along the way, make what you build safe to change. Restructure and test the paths you build on while you build on them. Extend test coverage where it's lacking. We move fast and keep quality up by automating what a human doesn't need to do, including the checks that catch what an agent got wrong.

What you'll do

  • Design and build frontend features starting from rough product ideas

  • Deliver features with Claude Code, from the prompt through to the pull request, and review the output as closely as a colleague's

  • Write the patterns, conventions and project context our agents work from, so generated frontend code lands in the right shape

  • Turn tangled domain rules into screens people can use without a manual

  • Fix bugs in your own features and in code you've never seen

  • Improve the code you touch while you touch it, so the next feature in that area costs less

  • Write and maintain automated tests in Jest and Playwright

  • Ship in short cycles with your product team

  • Pair, review, and teach what you know

How we work

Frontend in Angular, backend in PHP, a web app and a mobile app in React Native. Tests in Jest and Playwright. We develop AI-assisted with Claude Code as the primary tool, and a growing share of our code starts there. Human review and engineers owning what they ship keep it safe. We ship in short cycles in product teams with mixed specialisations. We pair often, with each other and with an agent open. Every quarter you get time to build and ship one of your own ideas, and we run hackathons.




Must-haves

3+ years of professional experience with an SPA framework, Angular preferred. Depth in React or Vue works if you can show you'll carry it over.

You ship. You've delivered features to real users at a steady pace, and you can tell us what you cut to get them out.

You've shipped production code with an AI agent. Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot or similar. Tell us where you let it run, where you took the keyboard back, and what you changed about your own workflow after a month of it.

You automate your tests. Jest and Playwright, or equivalents, and you have an opinion about what deserves a test.

You simplify. Hand you a tangled domain problem and you produce a screen that hides the tangle.

You explain your choices. In review, in a design discussion, and to a product manager who doesn't read code.

You work as a peer. You pair, you review, and you make the people around you better without needing a title to be heard.

Nice-to-haves

  • Claude Code in particular, or agent setups you've tuned for a team rather than yourself

  • TypeScript at depth

  • Storybook or component library ownership

  • React

  • TDD

  • PHP, or enough backend to reason about the API you're consuming

  • Familiarity with a complex, regulated domain (ours covers scheduling, time tracking, leave, and labour law across countries)

This might be your dream job if…

✅ You want your work in front of customers within days

✅ You'd rather own a feature end to end than take a finished spec

✅ You want a say in how a team writes frontend code with agents while the answer is still open

✅ You improve the code you touch without being asked, and you stop before it turns into a six-week rewrite

✅ You like a domain that takes months to learn

This probably isn't your dream job if…

⛔️ You want the technical approach decided before the ticket reaches you

⛔️ You want a job where AI stays out of your editor

⛔️ You'd merge agent output you can't explain in review

⛔️ You'd stop shipping to finish a refactor

⛔️ You prefer pixel work and would rather leave tests and architecture to someone else

⛔️ You'd rather work alone than pair and review

  • 32 or 40 hours workweek

  • Hybrid, from home or the Zoetermeer office

  • 25 vacation days based on a 40-hour contract

  • Pension plan

  • NS business card or travel expenses reimbursed.

  • Training budget for personal development

Please be aware that this is not a remote position and we are not taking applications in consideration outside of the Netherlands for this position.

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money. We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:

  • One of the UK’s most exciting unicorns with a team of over 800 people

  • Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK

  • Profitable since 2017

  • Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs

  • Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot)

So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

Join us if you want to

  1. Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

  2. Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions

  3. Build the best technology in-house: we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

About the role

We're looking for an analytics engineer to contribute to the analytical foundation of the UK Cards team, a growing area of the business.

You’ll work closely with analysts, product teams, backend engineers, and business stakeholders to improve how data is structured, transformed, and consumed across the company.

The role is fundamentally about building a strong analytical foundation: making it easier for teams to move from question to insight quickly, while maintaining high standards around data quality, scalability, and maintainability.

You'll contribute to the modelling layer, help improve how the business work with data, and support the team in keeping our warehouse a reliable, strategic asset for the business.

What you'll be doing

  • Building and improving the data models that support lending decisions, pricing, portfolio analysis, and investor reporting.

  • Championing standards and contributing to the improvement of our analytics engineering culture.

  • Supporting and collaborating with analysts at different technical levels,helping translate requirements into robust pipelines

  • Helping triage and resolve issues that affect the analytics pipeline or reduce trust in downstream datasets, and contributing ideas to improve the efficiency, reliability, and cost-effectiveness of our transformation pipeline over time.

Our modern data stack

You’ll work with a modern analytics stack centred around SQL, Snowflake, dbt, Fivetran and Claude.

What we're looking for

We’re looking for someone with solid analytics engineering fundamentals and the ability to apply them pragmatically in a fast-moving environment and explain tradeoffs to stakeholders with varying technical depth.

  • Strong DBT and SQL is a must

  • Strong data modelling skills and a good understanding of how analytical datasets should be structured for reliability and usability.

  • Strong experience with ELT pipelines and transformation at scale, ideally using dbt.

  • Experience with Snowflake or another modern cloud data warehouse.

  • Proactiveness in raising areas of data workflows that could be improved and suggesting solutions.

  • A collaborative working style and clear communication across technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Comfort using AI tools effectively to move faster, improve quality, and strengthen day-to-day analytical and engineering workflows

Interview process

  1. 15 minute cognitive assessment

  2. Initial chat

  3. 30 minute chat with hiring manager

  4. 60 minute technical interview

  5. 60 minute culture interview

Please note that unfortunately we're unable to sponsor for this position

Life at Lendable

  • Winning team: the opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies

  • Flexible working: flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sites

  • Socials & connection: opportunities and events to come together, socialise, and get to know each other beyond the office walls

  • Health coverage: support for your physical and mental wellbeing, including private health cover

  • Retirement & savings: long-term financial wellbeing through retirement savings plans

  • Employee referral programme: earn a competitive bonus when you refer successful new team members

  • Office meals & snacks: enjoy a fully stocked kitchen, plus complimentary lunches prepared by in-house chefs on in-office days at select locations

  • Sustainable commuting: cycle-to-work and electric vehicle salary sacrifice schemes available in select locations

You'll own customer lifecycle management for US Cards. That covers everything from a customer's first transaction through every part of their relationship with us. You'll join as we prove out the book, then take it into its next phase of growth. This suits someone who wants to shape a product while it's still being defined, not inherit a finished one.

You'll be part of a small team of data-driven problem solvers. Like most teams at Lendable, it's small relative to what it runs, so you'll own decisions and their implementation rather than handing them off. The work sits close to the proprietary AI and decisioning that lets us see people as individuals rather than credit scores. You'll be expected to use AI to build, test and analyse faster than a team our size otherwise could.

What you'll be doing

  • Owning the product vision and roadmap: first to market parity, then past it, for our current and expanding target segment, driven by customer understanding and experimentation.

  • Owning the customer lifecycle from first transaction onwards, including credit line management, spend and engagement growth, balance growth, pricing and proposition management, and retention and reactivation.

  • Shaping the mobile app experience to drive activation, spend and engagement.

  • Building new credit propositions alongside the core Cards product.

  • Executing hands-on: writing and resolving tickets, prototyping, and owning implementation and design decisions. You'll use AI tools to build the scrappiest thing that answers the question rather than waiting for engineering capacity.

  • Bringing Credit, Growth, Design, Data Science and Compliance with you, and partnering closely with US Cards Managing Director.

  • Setting clear, measurable goals and judging your work by whether the numbers moved, not by what shipped. You'll champion experimentation and never ship what you can't sense-check.


What we're looking for

Essential

  • A track record of owning product outcomes end to end. You make tough calls under ambiguity, own them, and course-correct when the evidence turns.

  • Strong analytical instinct:

  • a feel for what the numbers should look like

  • the instinct to notice when something is off

  • the persistence to find the real driver, without taking a confident answer from a dashboard or model at face value

  • Comfort working hands-on: writing and resolving tickets, prototyping, and making implementation and design decisions yourself.

  • Real fluency with AI tools as a working part of how you build, test and analyse.

  • The ability to lead through influence across Credit, Growth, Design, Data Science and Compliance. You change your mind when presented with a good argument, and you expect others to do the same.

Nice to have

  • Experience with consumer credit lifecycle levers such as credit line management, pricing, and retention and reactivation.

  • Experience shaping mobile app journeys for activation and engagement.

Interview process

  1. A quick chat with someone from our Talent team to see if the role is a good match.

  2. A 15-minute cognitive assessment.

  3. An interview with the Hiring Manager, covering your experience and how you approach the work.

  4. A practical exercise or case study relevant to the role, discussed with the team you'd be working with.

  5. A set of final interviews to assess how you'd thrive within our team and organisation.

Life at Lendable

title: AI  CAD CAM  IoT Engineer / Tinkerer CNC - Junior/Mid/Senior
description:
For over 10 years at Imnoo at Imnoo, we are bridging the gap between applied artificial intelligence and heavy industrial machinery.

We aren't just riding the recent AI wave, we have been deeply rooted in machine learning and statistical analysis for 10 years, delivering real, measurable value to a stable, loyal client base of manufacturers.

Imnoo is a leading SaaS platform built to analyze CNC parts, automate quoting and planning, and seamlessly connect the cloud with real manufacturers and shop-floor machines. We are looking for a unique hybrid—a CAD AI IoT Engineer / Tinkerer—who thrives at the intersection of software architecture and physical hardware. You won't just be writing code behind a desk; you will be the mastermind connecting our battle-tested algorithms directly to the pulse of the factory floor. If you love reverse-engineering industrial protocols, building edge data pipelines, and parsing complex 3D geometry to automate the business of manufacturing, this is your playground.

  1. The Ultimate Tinkerer’s Playground: You get to work with a dynamic mix of physical machines, Raspberry Pis/Industrial PCs, and modern cloud architectures.

  3. High Autonomy & Impact: You will be tackling unsolved problems in a fragmented industry, with the freedom to prototype, test, and deploy creative solutions.

  4. Shape the Industry: Play a critical role in a leading SaaS company that is actively transforming the contract manufacturing and CNC industry.


  1. CAD/CAM & Geometry Parsing: Proven experience working with CAD/CAM environments and deep knowledge of CAD/CAM API integration to programmatically extract feature data and metadata.

  2. Industrial IoT Connectivity: Hands-on IoT experience, specifically focused on extracting telemetry and operational data from the shop floor.

  3. Machine Controller Mastery: Experience connecting with and pulling data from diverse CNC controllers (e.g., Heidenhain, Fanuc, Siemens) using industrial protocols (OPC UA, MTConnect, FOCAS, etc.).

  4. Core Programming: Strong coding experience in Python, C++, C#, Node.js, or similar languages to build scalable integrations, edge agents, and rapid prototypes.

  5. Edge Deployment: Solid experience using Docker to containerize applications and reliably deploy them to industrial edge devices or gateways.

title: Business Analyst (gn)
description:
Festanstellung bei New Monday · Vollzeit · überwiegend remote innerhalb Deutschlands · gelegentliche Teamtreffen in Essen · Start zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt

Du verstehst komplexe Prozesse, bringst Struktur in Anforderungen und entwickelst daraus konkrete Lösungen? Bei New Monday suchen wir zwei Business Analyst für ein Kundenprojekt, das eine zentrale Herausforderung der Energiewende adressiert: den Netzausbau und die Integration von Erzeugungsanlagen.

Im Projekt entsteht ein Netzanschlusssystem mit drei miteinander verbundenen Anwendungen: einem Kundenfrontend, einem Installateursfrontend und einer Sachbearbeiterlösung. Gemeinsam mit den beteiligten Fachbereichen und Entwicklungsteams gestaltest du die fachlichen Grundlagen dafür, die durchgängigen Prozesse effizienter zu machen.

Über New Monday

Wir sind New Monday und begleiten Unternehmen bei der Entwicklung digitaler Produkte – von der ersten Idee über die Analyse und Konzeption bis hin zu Design und technischer Umsetzung. Dafür bringen wir Kompetenzen aus Business Analyse, UX/UI Design und Softwareentwicklung zusammen.

Als Teil von New Monday bringst du deine Expertise direkt in die Projekte unserer Kunden ein. Dort arbeitest du in der Regel als Mitglied des Kundenteams eng mit den jeweiligen Fachbereichen, Product Ownern und Entwicklungsteams zusammen. Du machst komplexe Anforderungen verständlich, hinterfragst bestehende Prozesse und gestaltest Lösungen, die Nutzer und Unternehmen weiterhelfen.

Dein berufliches Zuhause bleibt New Monday: Wir begleiten dich während deines Projekteinsatzes, unterstützen deine Weiterentwicklung und schaffen Raum für fachlichen Austausch und persönliche Begegnungen im Team.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du analysierst und strukturierst prozessuale Anforderungen und entwickelst fachliche sowie technische Umsetzungskonzepte.

  • Du übersetzt fachliche Bedarfe in klare, umsetzungsreife Spezifikationen als Grundlage für die technische Realisierung.

  • Du arbeitest dich in komplexe Systemlandschaften und ihre Prozesse ein, identifizierst Optimierungspotenziale und dokumentierst konkrete Handlungsbedarfe.

  • Du bearbeitest definierte Testpakete, führst Reviews durch und analysierst auftretende Fehler. Dabei dokumentierst und bewertest du Fehlerbilder aus fachlicher Sicht.

  • Du erarbeitest Lösungsoptionen und Handlungsempfehlungen und stimmst diese mit angrenzenden Rollen und Fachbereichen ab.

  • Du behältst den gesamten Prozess über die drei Anwendungen hinweg im Blick und hilfst dabei, den Nutzen der Lösung kontinuierlich zu verbessern.

Was du mitbringst

  • Erfahrung in der Business Analyse oder im Requirements Engineering für komplexe IT-Projekte.

  • Die Fähigkeit, fachliche und prozessuale Anforderungen systematisch aufzunehmen, zu hinterfragen und verständlich zu dokumentieren.

  • Technisches Verständnis, um Zusammenhänge, Abhängigkeiten und Schnittstellen innerhalb einer Systemlandschaft zu analysieren.

  • Erfahrung mit der Erstellung von Spezifikationen und Umsetzungskonzepten sowie in der Zusammenarbeit mit Fachbereichen und Entwicklungsteams.

  • Erfahrung mit fachlichen Tests, Reviews und der Analyse und Bewertung von Fehlern.

  • Eine strukturierte, eigenständige Arbeitsweise und Freude daran, gemeinsam tragfähige Lösungen zu entwickeln.

  • Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse.

  • Bereitschaft zu gelegentlichen Teamtreffen in Essen.

Das erwartet dich bei New Monday

  • Flexibles Arbeiten passend zum Projekt: In diesem Projekt arbeitest du überwiegend remote innerhalb Deutschlands. Gelegentliche Teamtreffen finden vor Ort in Essen statt.

  • Flexibilität und Vertrauen: Du organisierst deine Arbeit eigenständig und stimmst dich dabei mit deinem Kundenteam ab. Bei New Monday setzen wir auf kurze Abstimmungswege und Vertrauen.

  • Aufgaben mit Wirkung und Gestaltungsspielraum: Du bringst deine Erfahrung direkt im Kundenprojekt ein und gestaltest digitale Prozesse mit, die den Netzausbau und die Integration von Erzeugungsanlagen unterstützen.

  • Persönliche Begleitung im Projekteinsatz: Auch wenn dein Arbeitsalltag überwiegend im Kundenteam stattfindet, bleiben wir mit dir im Austausch und begleiten dich bei Fragen, Herausforderungen und deiner Entwicklung.

  • Ein Team, das sich auch persönlich trifft: Neben dem digitalen Austausch schaffen wir bewusst Raum für regionale Treffen und gemeinsames Coworking. Ein- bis zweimal im Jahr kommt das gesamte New-Monday-Team zusammen.

  • Zeit und Budget für deine Entwicklung: Wir fördern fachliche Weiterbildung und den Austausch im Team. Nach der Probezeit steht dir dafür ein Weiterbildungsbudget von 1.000 € zur Verfügung.

  • Entwicklung mit Perspektive: Wir arbeiten aktuell an einem Karriereentwicklungsplan, der Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten und nächste Schritte bei New Monday transparenter machen soll. Deine eigenen Ziele und Interessen besprechen wir regelmäßig mit dir.

  • 30 Tage Urlaub und zusätzlich zwei Tage für unsere Team-Events.

So geht es weiter

  • Erstes Kennenlernen: Wir erzählen dir mehr über New Monday, die Rolle und das Kundenprojekt. Du berichtest uns von deiner Erfahrung und kannst alle Fragen stellen, die dir wichtig sind.

  • Vertiefender Austausch: Wir sprechen ausführlicher über deine bisherigen Projekte, deine Arbeitsweise und deine Erfahrung in der Business Analyse und im Requirements Engineering.

  • Kennenlernen im Kundenprojekt: Wenn es für beide Seiten passt, stellen wir dich beim Kunden vor. Dort lernst du das Projektumfeld und die beteiligten Ansprechpartner kennen. Die weiteren Schritte stimmen wir transparent mit dir ab.

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung! Ein Anschreiben brauchst du nicht. Schick uns einfach deinen Lebenslauf – auch wenn du nicht jede Anforderung vollständig erfüllst!

New Monday fördert die Gleichstellung aller Beschäftigten. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Alter, Religion, Weltanschauung, Behinderung oder sexueller Identität. Menschen mit Schwerbehinderung werden bei gleicher Eignung unter Berücksichtigung der Umstände des Einzelfalls bevorzugt.

Dein Einstieg

Die Stelle ist auf 12 Monate befristet, umfasst 40 Stunden pro Woche und sieht eine Probezeit von 6 Monaten vor. Wenn du dich in den Anforderungen wiederfindest, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung über die Plattform.

title: SEO & Digital Marketing Specialist
description:
SEO & Digital Marketing Specialist – Technical SEO, Google Ads & Lead Generation | Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours
Experience Level: Mid-Level to Senior
Department: Digital Marketing / Growth Marketing

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring an experienced SEO & Digital Marketing Specialist to develop, execute, and optimize digital marketing strategies that increase organic traffic, improve search rankings, generate qualified leads, and drive measurable business growth.

The ideal candidate has strong expertise in technical SEO, Google Ads, paid social advertising, content optimization, marketing analytics, and automation. This is a hands-on role requiring someone who can independently manage campaigns, identify growth opportunities, and turn marketing data into actionable strategies.

You’ll take ownership of organic search performance, paid advertising, website optimization, and lead generation while exploring emerging opportunities in AI-powered search optimization (AEO/GEO).

Key Responsibilities

SEO Strategy & Optimization

  • Develop and execute SEO strategies to improve organic visibility, keyword rankings, and website traffic.
  • Conduct keyword research, competitor analysis, and search intent analysis.
  • Perform technical SEO audits, addressing indexing, crawling, site architecture, page speed, and mobile performance.
  • Optimize meta titles, descriptions, headings, internal linking, URLs, and structured data.
  • Execute ethical link-building strategies and monitor search algorithm updates.
  • Optimize content for traditional search engines and AI-powered search experiences (AEO/GEO).

Paid Advertising & Lead Generation

  • Plan, launch, and optimize campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads, and LinkedIn Ads.
  • Manage advertising budgets to improve lead quality, Cost per Lead (CPL), and Return on Ad Spend (ROAS).
  • Develop and optimize landing pages, lead capture forms, and conversion funnels.
  • Implement retargeting and remarketing campaigns.
  • Collaborate with sales teams to align marketing initiatives with revenue goals.

Content Marketing & Website Management

  • Develop SEO-driven content strategies aligned with business objectives.
  • Create and optimize website copy, blog articles, and landing pages.
  • Manage website updates through WordPress, Webflow, or similar CMS platforms.
  • Collaborate with designers, developers, and content creators to improve website performance and user experience.

Analytics, Reporting & Optimization

  • Monitor traffic, keyword rankings, conversions, and campaign performance using Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Search Console, and Google Tag Manager.
  • Build performance dashboards and provide actionable marketing reports.
  • Conduct A/B testing across landing pages, advertisements, and campaigns.
  • Analyze user behavior and identify opportunities to improve conversion rates.

Marketing Automation & CRM

  • Manage email marketing campaigns, lead nurturing sequences, and automated workflows.
  • Work with platforms such as HubSpot, GoHighLevel, Salesforce, or ActiveCampaign.
  • Improve lead tracking, marketing attribution, and sales handoffs.
  • Maintain accurate campaign data and performance reporting.

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years of professional experience in SEO, digital marketing, or performance marketing.
  • Proven success improving organic rankings, website traffic, and qualified lead generation.
  • Strong knowledge of technical SEO, on-page SEO, off-page SEO, and content optimization.
  • Hands-on experience with GA4, Google Search Console, Google Tag Manager, SEMrush, Ahrefs, or similar tools.
