title: Forward Deployed AI Engineer
description:
Forward Deployed AI Engineer

Build end-to-end products on a solid data foundation, with AI as a force multiplier.

Data Practice | Remote (Poland) | Senior

 

About TechTorch

At TechTorch, we’re building the future of intelligent work. Our mission is to help companies design, build, and deploy AI agents that automate complex, real-world workflows — delivering reliability, measurable ROI, and massive efficiency gains.

Here, you won’t just be playing with prompts or running endless proofs of concept. You’ll ship production-grade AI systems that solve real problems across industries.

You’ll join a hands-on, fast-moving, ownership-driven team that thrives on building quickly, iterating fast, and seeing results in days — not months.

 

About the Practice

TechTorch's Data Practice sits at the intersection of enterprise data and applied AI. We design and build AI-native systems that don't just analyze the past — they actively drive decisions. Our work spans data infrastructure and pipelines, intelligent automation, and full-stack AI applications across industries.

We work the way the best client-delivery teams now operate: small teams, deep ownership, no hand-offs at boundaries. We take problems from a client whiteboard to production, and we let AI do the heavy lifting wherever it earns its place.

The Role

We're looking for an engineer who builds across the full stack and owns the data underneath it. You can sit in a client session, shape the architecture, design the data foundation, and ship the application that runs on top of it — without handing off at the boundaries.

The work spans client delivery and internal accelerator development. You map the problem, structure the solution, and own the outcome from end to end. AI coding agents are central to how we build — not a novelty, but the daily layer that lets a small team cover a lot of ground.

What You'll Do

  • Own work end to end — from discovery and solution shaping through system design, build, and production deployment.

  • Design and build the data foundation: data models, schema design, dimensional modeling, ETL/ELT pipelines, and slowly changing dimensions (SCD) that hold up in production.

  • Build full-stack applications on top of that foundation — Python/FastAPI services and Next.js frontends that make data and AI workflows usable.

  • Use AI coding agents (Claude Code or equivalent) as a primary build accelerator to move from spec to working software quickly, without sacrificing judgment or quality.

  • Design and build AI capabilities where they fit — RAG pipelines, agentic workflows, and LLM-in-the-loop processing — and compose them via MCP servers, Skills, and Plugins.

  • Orchestrate pipelines and automation with tools like Airflow, Dagster/Prefect, Celery, or Temporal — choosing the right tool for the job.

  • Stand up and own CI/CD and cloud deployments on AWS and Azure.

  • Translate ambiguous client requirements into clear designs and communicate trade-offs to both technical and business audiences.

  • Contribute reusable accelerators and technical assets back to the Data Practice.

 

Must Have

We're looking for genuine production depth across data engineering and full-stack development — not surface familiarity with either.

Data Engineering Foundation

  • Data modeling and schema design — dimensional modeling, normalization trade-offs, and EDW/warehouse schema design you can defend.

  • Hands-on data pipeline experience — ETL/ELT design across batch and incremental loads, built and maintained in production (not just SQL scripts on a schedule).

  • Slowly Changing Dimensions (SCD) and change-data handling — knows the patterns and when each applies.

  • dbt Experience— modular SQL transformations, tests, documentation, and incremental strategies.

  • Advanced SQL and at least one modern data platform in depth (e.g., Snowflake, Databricks, or a comparable cloud warehouse/lakehouse).

  • Data quality thinking — testing, validation, and lineage treated as first-class, not afterthoughts.

Full-Stack AI Product Development

  • Python as a primary language — services, automation, and data work alike.

  • FastAPI — async REST API design, dependency injection, testing.

  • A modern frontend, ideally Next.js — component architecture, SSR, state management, and real UX sensibility.

  • PostgreSQL — schema design, query optimization, indexing.

  • System design — can architect from a blank page: services, boundaries, trade-offs, and scale.

  • AI-paired engineering — uses an agentic coding tool (Claude Code, Cursor, or comparable) as a genuine daily workflow accelerator, and can speak concretely to how.

  • CI/CD and cloud deployment ownership on AWS or Azure, without heavy support.

Ways of Working

  • Comfortable in client-facing delivery — can represent TechTorch technically and translate between business and engineering.

  • Customer-first mindset — anchors decisions in what the stakeholder is actually trying to accomplish, and can move fluidly between the engineer's view and the business owner's in the same conversation.

  • End-to-end ownership instinct — takes a problem from discovery to production and owns the outcome, rather than passing it along at each handoff.

Nice to Have

Not required to apply — but these are the things that make a candidate stand out.

Standout differentiator — Commercial data fluency: Experience evaluating how commercial data flows across CRM (ideally Salesforce) and ERP (ideally NetSuite) from opportunity to order to invoice, with the ability to diagnose, document, and resolve inconsistencies.

  • Agentic AI depth — LangGraph or comparable: multi-agent coordination, tool use, memory, and state management.

  • RAG engineering — retrieval strategies, vector stores, chunking, re-ranking, and evaluation.

  • Experience in a consulting or client-delivery environment, or a forward-deployed / embedded engineering role.

  • Workflow orchestration breadth across multiple tools (Airflow, Dagster, Prefect, Temporal, ADF, Databricks Workflows).

  • Streaming data patterns — Kafka, Spark Streaming, or Flink.

  • Vector databases — Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant, or pgvector.

  • Experiment tracking — MLflow, Weights & Biases, or similar.

  • Contributions to open-source AI or data tooling, or to internal accelerators and frameworks.

  • Multi-cloud or hybrid cloud architecture exposure.

You Might Be a Fit If...

  • You're comfortable designing a data model in the morning and shipping a FastAPI + Next.js feature on top of it in the afternoon.

  • You treat an AI coding agent as a force multiplier — you've genuinely changed how you build, not just turned on autocomplete.

  • You can explain an SCD strategy to an engineer and a data-quality risk to a business stakeholder in the same conversation.

  • You've shipped real things in production — not just demos or PoCs.

  • You're opinionated about system and data design, and can back it up.

What We Offer

  • Fully remote — work from anywhere, globally.

  • Semi-annual team offsites — we come together in person at least twice a year to connect, recharge, and do the work that's better face-to-face.

  • High-autonomy, high-ownership work across the full arc of real client problems — not toy datasets or boxed-in tickets.

  • A team that takes AI tooling seriously and expects you to use it, not just name-drop it.

  • Access to the full modern data and AI stack — no one-tool shops.

  • Room to grow toward data architecture, platform leadership, or AI engineering depth, depending on where you want to take it.

description:
The Role

 

We're hiring Product Designers to help shape how enterprises understand, govern, and trust their AI agents.

 

Geordie is building category-defining tooling for agent visibility, governance, and risk. The design challenge is real: AI agent behaviour is complex, often opaque, and the stakes for our customers are high.

 

Our design team is small today; you'll report into our Head of Product Design and join two Product Designers. We have three development teams, growing to five, and we believe design works best embedded. You'll join one of those teams as its designer, working alongside its engineers and customers every day. Because we're still early, you'll also help set the foundation everything else is built on: the design language, the component library, and the patterns we use across the product. Our design team also looks after Geordie's brand, so you'll help shape how we show up beyond the product too, making sure brand and product feel like one coherent experience.

 

Design here isn't a layer applied at the end. We ship multiple times a day, and we actively encourage designers to use AI agents to write code and get closer to the product. We don't have Product Managers; design and engineering partner directly to figure out what to build. Our engineers are deeply product-minded, close to customers, and want to solve the right problem rather than ship to spec. Together you'll define problems, shape scope, and own outcomes. If you've ever wanted to own something end to end, this is it.

 

We also move fast. We ship multiple times a day, and we actively encourage designers to use AI agents to write code and get closer to the product. If you've ever wanted to own something end to end, this is it.

 
 
 
 

What You'll Do

 

Own the end-to-end design of core product experiences, from early concept through to shipped and iterated.

 

Help build Geordie's design system with the rest of the design team; the tokens, components, patterns, and documentation that everyone relies on, shaped by what your team needs.

 

Contribute to Geordie's brand; helping evolve our visual language, illustration, and assets so the product and brand tell one story.

 

Lead customer discovery and research; running interviews, identifying patterns, and bringing customer insight into every design decision.

 

Work directly with customers to test your thinking early and close the loop between insight and shipped product.

 

Collaborate daily with engineers; pairing, reviewing, and increasingly using AI tools to prototype and contribute to the codebase yourself.

 

Contribute to product direction: you will be in the room where decisions are made, not handed a spec to execute.

 

Keep a strong point of view on what good design looks like in a security and governance product; clear, trustworthy, and built for expert users.

 
 
 

What We're Looking For

 

The most important thing is that you care deeply about customers and can move fast without losing quality. You are a strong practitioner; you can go from whiteboard to high-fidelity quickly, and you know when each is appropriate.

 

You are comfortable with ambiguity. We are Series A, the product is evolving, and the domain of AI agent governance is genuinely new. You find that energising, not unsettling.

 

You have strong opinions about design systems and component architecture, and experience building or significantly contributing to one. You can articulate why decisions were made and defend them clearly.

 

You work well in a collaborative engineering culture. You are comfortable pair-designing with engineers, reviewing pull requests for design quality, and using AI tools to accelerate your own work.

 
 

Requirements

 

Significant experience as a product designer, with a portfolio that demonstrates complex UX problem-solving; not just polished visuals.

 

Experience designing highly complex B2B SaaS products, including data visualisation and data-dense interfaces; you can turn large volumes of information into something expert users can understand and act on.

 

Proven ability to work across the full design process: research, concept, detailed design, and handoff.

 

Strong product thinking; you can define the problem, question the brief, and help decide what to build, not just how it should look.

Background working at an early-stage startup where you built things from scratch.

AI agents are changing how companies operate, and the question of how to govern them safely is only going to grow. Geordie is building the platform enterprises rely on to answer that question.

title: Senior Sales Engineer, DACH Channel
description:
Get to Know Us

Horizon3 is a fast-growing, remote cybersecurity company dedicated to the mission of enabling organizations to proactively find and fix and verify exploitable attack vectors before criminals exploit them. Our flagship product, the NodeZeroTM platform, delivers production-safe autonomous pentests and other key assessment operations that scale across the largest internal, external, cloud, and hybrid cloud environments. NodeZero has been adopted by organizations of all sizes, from small educational institutions to government agencies and Global 100 enterprises. It is used by ITOps/SecOps teams, consulting pentesters, and MSSPs and MSPs.

We are a fusion of former U.S. Special Operations cyber operators, startup engineers, and formerly frustrated cybersecurity practitioners. We're committed to helping solve our common security problems: ineffective security tools, false positives resulting in alert fatigue, blind spots, "checkbox” security culture, cybersecurity skills shortage, and the long lead time and expense of hiring outside consultants. Collectively, we are a team of learn it alls, committed to a culture of respect, collaboration, ownership, and results.

What You’ll Do

The Channel Sales Engineer is responsible for supporting Horizon3’s channel ecosystem by enabling managed service partners to design, demonstrate, and deliver NodeZero-powered offerings to their customers. This role is partner-focused, requiring a balance of technical expertise, pre-sales support, and enablement skills. The Sales Engineer will ensure that MSP/MSSP partners are technically capable, strategically aligned, and empowered to independently deliver and expand Horizon3’s value within their customer base. This role will focus on our partners in the DACH region.

Key Responsibilities

  • Partner Enablement

    • Deliver technical training, workshops, and certifications to ensure MSP/MSSP partners can independently position and deliver NodeZero

    • Assist partners in building repeatable service offerings around continuous pentesting, compliance validation, and attack surface management

    • Develop technical collateral, playbooks, and best practices to support partner go-to-market strategies

  • Pre-Sales & Technical Advisory

    • Support MSP/MSSP partners in customer-facing opportunities by delivering demos, presentations, and POVs

    • Collaborate with Horizon3’s channel sales managers to align partner capabilities with customer requirements

    • Provide guidance on solution design, service integration, and technical scoping for partner-driven opportunities

  • Collaboration & Feedback

    • Act as a trusted advisor to partners on offensive security and evolving threat landscapes

    • Gather partner and customer insights to inform Horizon3’s product roadmap and enablement strategies

    • Build strong working relationships with Sales, Product, and Customer Success to ensure partner success

Qualifications & Experience

  • 3+ years in a pre-sales, technical consulting, SOC, or red team role; MSP/MSSP or cybersecurity services experience highly preferred

  • Strong knowledge of offensive and defensive security, penetration testing methodologies, vulnerability management, and security operations

  • Familiarity with managed services delivery models, SOC workflows, SIEM, SOAR, EDR, PTaaS and MDR

  • Proficiency with cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP), identity systems (AD/AAD), and networking fundamentals

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills across technical and business stakeholders

  • Experience in partner enablement or channel ecosystems

  • Certifications such as OSCP, OSCE, CISSP, CEH, CompTIA Security+, or cloud security certifications are desirable

  • Fluent in German and English

Core Competencies

  • Partner Enablement – ability to upskill partners and develop scalable enablement programs.

  • Technical Depth – expertise in offensive security and managed security operations.

  • Collaboration – works effectively with internal teams and external partners.

  • Business Acumen – aligns technical solutions with partner and customer business goals.

  • Proactive Mindset – anticipates partner needs and drives adoption without requiring direction.

Performance Indicators

  • Partner technical readiness (training completions, certifications, enablement metrics)

  • Increase in independent partner-led NodeZero opportunities

  • Growth in MSP/MSSP revenue contribution

  • Partner satisfaction and engagement scores

  • Contribution of partner feedback to product and service improvements

Travel Required

This role is fully remote, and this job may require up to 50% of travel to be successful. Job-related travel expenses are reviewed and must be approved by your manager.

Perks of Horizon3

  • Inclusive Team: We value diversity and promote an inclusive culture where everyone can thrive.

  • Growth Opportunities: Be part of a dynamic and growing team with numerous career development opportunities.

  • Innovative Culture: Work in a collaborative environment that encourages creativity and out-of-the-box thinking.

  • Competitive Compensation: We offer competitive salary, equity and benefits.

 

Compensation and Values

At Horizon3, we believe that our people are our greatest asset, and our compensation philosophy reflects this core value. We are committed to fostering an environment where all employees feel valued, respected, and rewarded for their contributions. Our compensation structure is designed to be fair, competitive, and transparent, ensuring that every team member is recognized and compensated equitably across roles, levels, and locations.

  • Depending on experience, the compensation range for this position is: €160,000 - €190,000 OTE 70/30 split annually. The exact salary will be determined based on the selected candidate’s location, qualifications, experience, and relevant skills.

  • Additional compensation: All full-time roles are eligible for an equity package in the form of stock options.

You Belong Here

Horizon3 is not just an equal opportunity employer - we are a community that values diversity, equity, and inclusion as fundamental principles of our culture and success. We are dedicated to fostering a workplace where everyone feels welcome and respected, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, hair length or any other legally protected status by law.

Our commitment to diversity and inclusion means we strive to attract, develop, and retain a workforce that reflects the varied communities we serve. We believe that diverse perspectives drive innovation and strengthen our ability to create cutting-edge cybersecurity solutions. At Horizon3, every team member is valued and supported in an environment that encourages personal and professional growth.

We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and experiences, and we encourage all qualified individuals to apply. Come be a part of Horizon3, where your unique contributions are recognized, and your potential is limitless.

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
View our much better version of this job spec on our careers page: https://juro.notion.site/...

 

***

 

THE KEY BITS

 

  • Location: We can currently only accept applications from candidates that are located and have long-term working rights in the UK.

  • Flexibility: We operate a choice-first work approach that lets you work fully remotely from Day One even if you’re near our London office hub.

  • Salary: We benchmarked £90,000 + equity at IC4 level in our progression framework for someone based in the UK. If you like the look of the role but the salary doesn’t match what you’re looking for, let us know in the application.

  • Interviews: 3 stages totalling around 3 hours over 2-3 weeks. See FAQ for detail.

  • Start date: As soon as you can start.

  • Reporting to: Keith Reid, Head of Product

  • More info: The FAQ below, juro.com/careers, our handbook or ask ----- anything.

 
 

HELP US HELP THE WORLD AGREE FASTER

Juro has big ambitions: to become the go-to platform for agreeing and managing contracts globally. And we'll need help doing it.

Legal tech is on the rise, with Goldman Sachs estimating that 44% of legal tasks can be automated with generative AI. With the brand we have built and the agility of early stage we are well placed to capture this opportunity.

 

Signing a contract is the easy part. Everything before it (multiple parties, several legal documents, opposing interests, a redlining process most companies still run through email attachments) is where contracting actually gets hard.

That's the part of Juro you'll own. It's the most ambitious area of the product and the one with the most room to change how contracting feels for the people doing it day to day.

We're not handing you a blank page. There's a roadmap in place and a team ready to build it. We want you shipping against it while you're forming your own view of the problem, then tell us which parts of it were wrong.

Every PM at Juro is hired to make product bets that pay out. Great means that:

  1. the bets you own deliver real outcomes for customers quickly, and

  2. those outcomes show up in revenue.

What you're here to do:

  • Ship against the contract workflow roadmap in your first few weeks.

  • Get close to the problem rapidly. Talk to customers and prospects yourself. Form your own view of the jobs to be done rather than inheriting ours.

  • It's an agentic flow where "good redline" depends on the customer's playbook rather than any fixed answer, so a lot of the work is deciding what good means with customers and then holding engineering to it. It spans your team and our Agentic team, so some of what you own won't sit neatly in one place.

  • Work shoulder to shoulder with engineering, design and GTM to turn all of that into something people actually enjoy using.

  • Measure whether any of it worked and be honest when it didn't. Iterate or pivot when necessary.

Six months in, success looks like customers telling us unprompted that contracting in Juro got a lot more delightful and reaching for it in places they used to reach for Word.

 

We care about building a diverse team where everyone feels they belong. That’s why our perks & benefits and choice-first work approach are designed with inclusivity in mind. Read more in our diversity, inclusion & belonging hub.

 
 

WHO WE LOOK FOR

 

Research shows that while men apply to jobs if they meet ~60% of criteria, women and those in traditionally under-represented groups tend to apply only if they check all boxes. So if you think you have what it takes but don't meet every single point above, please still get in touch. We'd love to have a chat and see if you could be a great fit.

 

To succeed here:

Every Juror finds their balance across our four core principles — we hire, develop and celebrate people who live them every day.

Curious how you’d fit? Try our personality quiz to see how you map against our principles.

On top of that, you have been part of a journey where:

  • You've landed in a domain you knew nothing about and were making judgment calls within weeks. Ideally more than once.

  • You've owned something complex and multi-quarter from discovery through launch and iteration + were accountable when it slipped.

  • You've built for users you got to know directly, not through Sales or Customer Success. That means you've sat with them, watched them work and can tell us what they taught you.

  • You've worked shoulder to shoulder with GTM and engineering through launches + have been the trusted go-to person for them in past companies.

  • You understand why evals matter and how agentic loops work.*

  • You run your own discovery. Customer calls, prospect calls, synthesising messy qualitative input into a clear view of what to build.

  • You've brought ideas unprompted and built them without waiting for permission. Something small shipped in days beats a perfect spec written in weeks.

Bonus if:

  • You've owned the quality of an agentic system in production.

  • Legal tech or contracting experience.

  • You've worked on collaboration or multiplayer editing tools.

*What we care about is that you will dig into how a system actually behaves when you need to: work out why a flow is producing rubbish, go back and forth with engineers until it isn't. You don't need to have done this full time.

This job likely isn’t for you if:

  • You need someone to teach you the domain before you can be useful.

  • You'd rather run the process than talk to customers.

  • You think of AI as something the engineers deal with.

  • You treat design as a service that receives your specs. Here you'd decide what to build alongside a designer, not hand it over.

  • You want a settled team and a clean remit. Our product org will change, and some of your scope will cut across other teams.

  • You'd want to spend your first quarter rewriting the roadmap before shipping any of it.

  • You've been managing PMs and want to carry on doing that. This is hands-on.

 
 

OUR MISSION

Juro exists to help the world agree faster by making it incredibly easy for anyone to agree and manage legal contracts.

Frustrated by the absurdly slow process of taking a contract from inception through to agreement, Juro co-founders Richard and Pavel thought there must be a better way. They set out in 2016 to build a flexible, collaborative platform that anyone could use to process a legal contract end-to-end in their browser.

Fast forward 8 years and we have helped our customers process 2 million contracts in over 85 countries. Some of the world’s fastest-growing businesses, like Deliveroo, Remote, and Trustpilot have relied on Juro to help them streamline routine contracts at scale across multiple years of their growth.

But our story is just beginning.‍ Read more about our vision for intelligent contract automation.

 
 

GOT MORE QUESTIONS?

 

Check if they're answered on:

  • Our extended job description for this role: https://juro.notion.site/...

  • Our company handbook: https://juro.notion.site/handbook

  • Our careers page: https://juro.notion.site

 

There, you'll find answers on topics such as career progression, inclusion & belonging, the interview process, benefits and more. Or reach ----- for anything.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Backend - Distributed Systems
description:
Camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration, enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems across complex, end-to-end business processes. With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide, including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences.

Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform. We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team.

Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies, We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading.

About the Role:

As a Senior Software Engineer, Backend on Camunda’s Distributed Systems team, you’ll help build and evolve the durable, highly available, horizontally scalable streaming platform that underpins Camunda 8’s Orchestration Cluster and powers mission‑critical processes for customers around the world.

As part of the Distributed Systems team, you will work on technically challenging and rewarding projects, such as expanding on our multi-Raft implementation, our SWIM-based cluster membership algorithm, or high performance network and disk I/O pipelines.

At Camunda, we approach engineering in a holistic manner. As such, you will form strong partnerships with product management, design, QA, and sales, and work with your peers to not only deliver but directly influence the evolution of our platform to meet our customer’s needs.

Curious about the kind of challenges you'll work on at Camunda? Watch this quick 30-minute talk from our engineers to learn more about the new Camunda Exporter and how we’re solving complex problems at scale

What You Will Do:

  • Design, build, and maintain backend services for the distributed streaming platform that powers the foundation for Camunda 8’s orchestration capabilities, ensuring durability, high availability, and horizontal scalability.

  • Lead medium‑to‑large engineering initiatives (3+ months) end‑to‑end: partner with Product to translate business problems into technical requirements, write solution designs, draft and maintain project plans, and drive timely, high‑quality delivery.

  • Help mature our disaster recovery and resilience story, including implementing and evolving an online backup/restore API and contributing to improved multi‑region and multi‑tenant capabilities for our cloud offering.

  • Design and implement developer and operator tooling that makes it easier to understand, troubleshoot, and safely operate a complex distributed system in production environments.

  • Improve engineering effectiveness by collaborating with DevOps and other Core Application teams on CI, testing, and local development workflows to reduce PR time‑to‑merge and the overhead of working on multiple features in parallel.

  • Participate in L3 support and on‑call rotations, partnering closely with Support and SRE to investigate and resolve complex, performance‑sensitive production issues, and feeding what you learn back into our product and platform.

What You Will Bring to the Role:

Must Haves:

  • 7+ years of professional experience as a software engineer, with a strong focus on backend systems and/or distributed systems.

  • Proven experience leading medium‑to‑large engineering initiatives (roughly 3+ months), breaking down ambiguous problems, writing clear solution designs and project plans, coordinating with multiple teams, and driving predictable delivery.

  • Hands‑on experience building and maintaining highly concurrent, data‑intensive software, with a deep understanding of low‑level network and disk I/O (for example, throughput, latency, backpressure, batching, and failure modes).

  • Demonstrated ability to work autonomously and navigate ambiguity – you are comfortable taking on problems you haven’t solved before, breaking them down into concrete steps, and driving them to completion with minimal supervision.

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills in a remote‑first environment: you tailor explanations to your audience, translate business requirements into actionable technical work with Product, and help teams reach clear, decisive outcomes with minimal churn.

Nice to Haves:

  • Experience building workflow automation or process orchestration software.

  • Experience with distributed systems algorithms or protocols such as Raft, Paxos, SWIM, and/or CRDTs.

  • Strong familiarity with the observability pillars (logging, metrics, tracing) and how to integrate observability into the development and incident lifecycle, ideally including experience with L3 support and on‑call.

  • Deep knowledge of the Java Virtual Machine, especially its memory model and performance characteristics in highly concurrent, data‑intensive workloads.

What We Have to Offer:

Compensation

We offer competitive, fair, and transparent compensation. Salary ranges are location-based, with Standard and Major markets (global tech hubs) reflecting local competition.

The Annual Total Target Cash (base salary + 100% variable target, where applicable) shown below spans from the minimum in a Standard market to the maximum in a Major market. Final offers depend on skills, experience, and location, and we typically hire in the first half of the range to allow room for growth:

  • United States: $143,800.00 to $231,900.00

  • United Kingdom: £90,300.00 to £148,500.00

  • Singapore: S$178,600.00 to S$267,900.00

If you’re based elsewhere, you’ll be hired via Remote.com (our global employer partner), and your Talent Acquisition Partner will provide a personalized Total Rewards Calculator after your first interview.

Equity: We also offer equity (where applicable) through our Virtual Stock Option Plan (VSOP).

Benefits & Perks

We invest in your wellbeing, growth, and ability to connect, along with perks that support you no matter where you’re based. Our benefits are globally designed and locally delivered where applicable.

  • Remote & Flexible: Work from anywhere with the setup that suits you, home office budget, co-working space support, and flexible time off to recharge when you need it.

  • In Person Connection: We invest in meaningful face time through our Annual Kickoff (Vienna in 2025, Madrid in 2026!), team offsites, and Camundi Connection Budgets, including contributing to meetups while travelling,, and local gatherings with fellow Camundi.

  • Health & Wellbeing: Access locally tailored healthcare, Modern Health for global mental wellbeing, and our Live Well Lifestyle Spending Account (LSA), a flexible, global benefit that puts you in control of your whole life, not just work, from: staying active, to caring for family, exploring personal passions, meaningful experiences, and investing in your financial wellbeing. The Live Well program launches in 2026 and scales to €1,000 annually from 2027.

  • Financial Security: Retirement and pension plans (often with company contributions), plus life and disability insurance where relevant.

  • Professional Growth: Up to $/€/£1,000 per year for self-driven learning: courses, certifications, books, you decide!

AI in our hiring process: Camunda may use AI tools to aid the screening of applications and during the interview process. You can learn more here

”Everyone is welcome at Camunda” — it’s a celebrated component of our culture. We strive to create an inclusive environment that empowers our people. At Camunda, we honour diverse cultures and backgrounds and are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to gender, race, ethnicity, religion, belief, sexual orientation, age, disability or any other protected characteristics under applicable law. We are looking forward to your application!

Come join us and be part of Camunda’s incredible journey: Make an impact at a pivotal moment in our story!

Please be aware that scammers may impersonate Camunda by reaching out about job opportunities. Camunda will only contact candidates from an email address ending in @camunda.com or @talent.camunda.com. We will never ask candidates for bank account details, checks, payment, or other sensitive financial information as part of our hiring process. If you receive a suspicious message, please do not respond, click any links, or share personal information.

Note for recruiting and placement agencies: Camunda does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our careers site, employees, or any other Camunda contact unless we have specifically engaged your firm for that search. Camunda will not pay fees related to unsolicited resumes.

title: Unbezahltes Praktikum in Hamburger Start-Up | Social Media & Creative Marketing (m/w/d)
description:
Lust, eine Marke von Anfang an mitzugestalten? Bei 7 Elements machen wir Elektrolyte ohne Zucker — ohne Bullshit und Füllstoffe, über unseren eigenen Shop verkauft, entwickelt von unserer Gründerin, einer Ärztin. Übernimm unser TikTok und Instagram, arbeite mit Creatorn, dreh eigene Videos und probier aus, was funktioniert. Werde Teil eines kleinen Hamburger Teams mit kurzen Wegen, in dem deine Ideen nicht untergehen, sondern maßgeblich mitgestalten.

Aufgaben

  • TikTok: Du entwickelst Ideen, drehst, schneidest und veröffentlichst. Vom Trend-Hook bis zum eigenen Format.
  • Instagram: Du pflegst Feed und Stories und hältst die Bildsprache konsistent.
  • Influencer und UGC: Du suchst passende Creator, sprichst sie an, betreust die Zusammenarbeit und sorgst dafür, dass am Ende Content herauskommt, den wir auch nutzen können.
  • Content-Produktion: Du machst eigene Fotos und Videos — Produkt, Lifestyle, Behind the Scenes.
  • KI-Tools: Wir arbeiten intern mit KI für Bild, Text und Automatisierung. Du nutzt diese Tools aktiv und baust unsere Workflows mit aus.
  • Richtung mitbestimmen: Du bringst eigene Formate und Kanäle ein, testest sie und sagst uns ehrlich, was funktioniert und was nicht.
  • Du entscheidest, was dir am meisten Spaß macht!

Qualifikation

  • Du bist offen und kommunikativ und hast Lust, als rechte Hand der CEO an spannenden Projekten zu arbeiten.
  • Du begeisterst dich für Vertrieb und Marketing, KI und Prozessoptimierung und bist motiviert, deine Fähigkeiten weiter auszubauen.
  • Du bist sicher im Umgang mit sozialen Netzwerken.
  • Du hast sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und ausreichende Englischkenntnisse.
  • Du hast idealerweise drei bis sechs Monate Zeit, die du mit uns verbringen möchtest.

Benefits

  • 50% Remote möglich
  • Start-Up Mentalität hautnah von einem in Hamburger gegründeten Start-Up mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen
  • Regelmäßiges Feedback, viel Gestaltungsspielraum und die Chance eigene Ideen umzusetzen bieten dir die Möglichkeit wertvolle Erfahrungen fürs Berufsleben zu sammeln
  • Energetisches Arbeitsumfeld! Du hast eine Idee? Dann setzen wir sie gemeinsam um!
  • Echte Verantwortung ab Tag eins. Unsere Kanäle sind deine Kanäle. Du bekommst keine Zuarbeiten, sondern Themen.
  • Seite an Seite mit einer Ärztin. Du arbeitest direkt mit der Gründerin zusammen, die das Produkt selbst entwickelt hat. Du lernst, worüber du schreibst — und wie man über Gesundheitsthemen kommuniziert, ohne Unsinn zu behaupten. Diese Sicherheit haben die wenigsten Marketing-Leute in dieser Branche.
  • Du siehst, wie unternehmerische Entscheidungen entstehen — von der Produktidee bis zur Zahl im Backend.
  • Du lernst, wie eine D2C-Marke wirklich funktioniert. Am Ende weißt du nicht nur, wie man Content produziert, sondern auch, was davon Umsatz bringt. Das nimmst du mit, egal wohin du danach gehst.
  • Moderner Tool-Stack. Shopify, KI-gestützte Content- und Automatisierungstools, saubere Prozesse.
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten, abgestimmt auf deinen Stundenplan.
  • Produkt inklusive. Elektrolyte für dein Training gibt es selbstverständlich dazu.
  • Bei beidseitigem Interesse: Perspektive auf eine feste Zusammenarbeit im Anschluss.

Deine Ansprechpartnerin wird Nataliya Zaprudska sein. Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen!

Eye Security is providing cybersecurity with embedded cyber insurance solutions for organizations in Europe. Headquartered in the Netherlands, we are already over 190 FTEs and continue to grow internationally having secured our Series C funding of €60 Million!

We combine cutting-edge technology with hands-on expertise to detect, respond to, and recover from cyber threats in real time. Our team brings together talent from intelligence, military, tech, and consulting backgrounds — all united by a shared mission: to make enterprise-grade cybersecurity accessible to every business, not just the big players.

At Eye, you'll work on projects with an international footprint, solving real-world challenges and helping to build a safer digital future for our clients.

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager – Managed Detection and Incident Response (m/f/x) to join our Product team.

As our client base continues to grow rapidly across Europe, this role will play a key part in scaling our Managed Detection and Response (MDR), Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR), and Incident Response (IR) capabilities — Eye Security's most strategic product area.

You'll take full ownership of the product strategy and roadmap for this space. Collaborating with our engineers, product designers, security operations, and product marketing, you will ensure that our platform evolves with our customers' needs and delivers maximum impact.

This is a senior individual contributor role designed for someone who thrives on autonomy, discovery, and leading cross-functional product development in a fast-growing environment.

What you will do

  • Define and own the product strategy and roadmap for MDR, EDR, and IR, ensuring alignment with our overall product vision and company OKRs.

  • Work closely with Engineering, Product Design, Security Operations, Product Marketing, Customer Success, and Sales teams to deliver successful outcomes.

  • Partner with Product Marketing to define go-to-market plans and deliver clear, compelling product launches.

  • Manage external relationships, especially with EDR vendors and MDR technology providers, ensuring alignment with our MSP and partner ecosystem.

  • Contribute to the evolution of our internal processes, tooling, and product culture, helping Eye Security scale sustainably.

  • Stay up to date with cybersecurity trends, emerging technologies, and industry best practices to drive innovation and maintain competitive advantage.

What you will need

  • 5+ years of Product Management experience, with at least 2 years in a senior role owning end-to-end delivery of software products in B2B SaaS or similar environments.

  • Deep understanding of cybersecurity principles and best practices, especially in Managed Detection & Response (MDR), Endpoint Detection & Response (EDR), and Incident Response (IR).

  • Proven track record of successfully delivering complex software products in a fast-paced environment, using product discovery and data-driven decision making.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence without direct authority.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset.

  • Experience working in an agile development environment.

  • Fluent English; German language (C2) is required

Nice-to-have

  • Startup or scale-up background at a high-growth company.

  • Experience building or scaling product management teams and processes.

  • Exposure to OKR-driven product development and metrics-focused product management.

  • Experience working with MSP or partner-led go-to-market models.

  • Track record of navigating successful product pivots or strategic repositioning.

What we offer

  • A meaningful mission: protect organizations across Europe from real-world cyber threats.

  • Work with top-tier professionals from national CERTs, intelligence agencies, and leading tech backgrounds.

  • Full strategic ownership of a mission-critical product area in a high-growth cybersecurity scale-up.

  • Mentorship and growth: lead and develop the next generation of product managers; grow into broader strategy and leadership roles.

  • A remote-friendly culture with quarterly meetups and annual company retreats (in Spain, Portugal, Italy…).

  • Weekly lunches (NL) and Thursday socials to stay connected.

  • A generous time-off policy, including wellbeing and volunteering days.

  • Competitive salary and benefits package, including equity participation.

Are you up for it?

We look forward to receiving your application.

Small teams, real ownership, no layer of middle management between you and the client or the founders. You're trusted with real work from week one, combined with the right level of support. We pair, we share what we learn, and we're honest about what's working and what isn't.

title: Software Engineer - BrandX
description:
Olo is a leading SaaS platform accelerating digital transformation in the restaurant industry, by helping customers deliver more personalised and profitable guest experiences. As a result, our digital ordering, payment, loyalty and guest engagement solutions enable brands to do more with less and make every guest feel like a regular.

While our roots are in NYC, we’re intentionally investing in Belfast and Northern Ireland as a key hub, with an established leadership presence, a local team, and community for the long term. This role is fully remote, offering you flexibility to work from anywhere within NI.

Your new role

In this role, you’ll join as a Software Engineer on the ‘BrandX’ team, which is part of the wider ‘Order Engineering’ group.

BrandX (Brand Experience) builds the tools restaurant brands and Olo's internal teams use to run their business on Olo. We own the Dashboard that brand operators log into every day, the internal Admin application, and the billing and invoicing systems that turn platform usage into invoices. We also own how brands sign in and manage their users, including SSO and two-factor authentication, and we are building Olo AI Assist, a natural-language assistant inside the Dashboard.

The team is seven engineers spread across the US and Europe, and you'd be our first hire in Northern Ireland. Because the team sits between brands, Finance, and the rest of Order Engineering, the work is varied. One week you might be shipping a new Dashboard settings page, the next you're tracing a billing discrepancy across our finance integrations or teaching Olo AI Assist a new skill so a brand can update hours across hundreds of stores just by asking. You'll pair with senior engineers, review and ship code most days, and use Claude Code as a normal part of how you work.


How you’ll make an impact

  • Learn the BrandX domain and technology stack, and get to know the brands, Finance partners, and Order Engineering teams we work with.

  • Own small-to-medium features end to end, from understanding the requirement to shipping it, with senior engineers available when you need them.

  • Write code that meets our standards, and participate in code reviews as both author and reviewer.

  • Build reliable and maintainable software, with test coverage that matches the risk of the change.

  • Contribute to the team’s delivery pipeline, including test coverage, CI, and deployment practices.

  • Use Claude Code and GitHub Copilot as your default way of building, and help the team push what these tools can do.

  • Troubleshoot and debug production issues, learning how our systems fit together along the way.

  • Participate in team ceremonies such as daily stand-ups and retrospectives, sharing updates and feedback.

  • Take part in learning activities, including game days and training sessions, to build familiarity with Olo’s tools and processes.

  • Join the on-call rotation, with responsibilities that grow as you learn the team’s systems.


    • What will set you up for success

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 1 to 3 years of professional software engineering experience, or a strong portfolio of shipped projects.

  • Working knowledge of C# and .NET, and comfort reading code you didn't write.

  • Some experience building web UIs. We use React and TypeScript, but any modern framework is a fine starting point.

  • Comfortable with SQL and relational data. A lot of our work is understanding how data moves between systems.

  • You understand the difference between unit, integration, and end-to-end tests and when each one earns its place.

  • AI coding agents are your default way of working. You use tools like Claude Code daily, you can explain the fundamentals underneath what they generate, and you're excited about a team that expects you to push them further. 

  • You ask questions early, write things down, and are comfortable working with colleagues in other time zones.

Over 800 restaurant brands trust Olo and its network of more than 400 integration partners to innovate on behalf of the restaurant community, accelerating technology’s positive impact and creating a world where every restaurant guest feels like a regular. title: Growth Manager

Who we are

Yubo is the Social Discovery app to make new friends and hang out online. By eliminating likes and follows, we empower our users to create genuine connections and show up as their true selves.

We've pioneered a new way for Gen Z to socialize online, and with millions of active users, our goal is to redefine how we connect today and tomorrow.

Our team is international, multicultural and deeply committed to its mission. As the leading platform to socialize online, we have a special responsibility to build a safe digital space for our community. Safety is embedded in our DNA, and our proactive approach focuses on user protection, support, and education.

Join us in this exciting journey and help us shape the future of social interactions!

About this role

Growth at Yubo moves fast, and we don’t plan on stopping anytime soon ! More channels, more markets, more experiments to run, and we need brains (and hands…) to make it happen. We're bringing in a third Growth Manager to grow the team's capacity and add a perspective on Gen Z that comes from living it, being molded by it.

Sounds like you? You’ll like what comes next.

We’ll get you started by getting hands-on with every channel we operate, learning how each and every single one of them works before claiming your own piece of the portfolio. From there, a whole new world of possibilities opens up: push creative testing further, chase down new partners, help us uncover growth where we haven't looked yet, and more.

You'll work shoulder to shoulder with the rest of the Growth team (that includes Creative), Product, and Data, all pulling in the same direction. If you want a role where your instincts, ideas, and results speak for themselves, this is it.

Your responsibilites

  • User Acquisition & Paid Media Optimization: Manage and optimize a significant performance marketing budget across key acquisitoin channels, programmatic networks & emerging platforms. Scale acquisition and reactivation across multiple countries. Improve media buying, targeting, and creative to boost ROAS, using incrementality tests and attribution models. Help deploy automation and AI tools.

  • Creative Optimization: Collaborate with the creative team to ideate, produce and scale creative concepts that resonate with our Gen Z audience. Own creative testing and iteration to improve the scale, efficiency and longevity of winning ideas.

  • Growth Marketing: Support a multi-channel strategy that combines paid and brand marketing to drive organic, viral and referral loops. Contribute to ASO and lifecycle marketing to boost retention and monetization.

  • Data-Driven Growth: Partner with Product, Data, and Engineering to optimize funnels. Build dashboards and A/B testing processes. Stay ahead of privacy and adtech trends (e.g SKAN, AdAttributionKit).

  • Collaboration: Work with senior growth team members, share best practices, and foster a culture of experimentation and data-driven decisions.

Tools we use

  • MMP: Adjust

  • Analytics & dataviz: Amplitude

  • Market intelligence: Sensor Tower and Creative Ad Libraries

  • Acquisition channels: TikTok, Meta, Snapchat, Google Ads, Apple Ads

  • Programmatic networks: AppLovin, Moloco

Who you are

  • You have around 3 years of solid, consolidated experience in growth marketing or user acquisition for a B2C consumer app.

  • You have a genuine, native affinity with Gen Z culture and what makes it tick.

  • You have experience or a strong connection with the US market, whether through studies or product marketing experience.

  • You've scaled growth investment on at least one major social media platform and know how to read the results.

  • You know how to collaborate with creative teams: identifying what works, and clearly explaining why.

  • You have experience working with a martech stack, including custom audiences, conversion APIs, and MMP & SDK implementations and updates.

  • You're autonomous, result-oriented, and bring strong business acumen to your decisions.

Within a month, you will

  • Get to know Yubo's product, mission, and the Growth team's ways of working.

  • Meet your key stakeholders across Growth, Creative, Product, and Data.

  • Get onboarded on our tools and marketing stack, including Adjust, Amplitude and more

  • Start learning how each of our acquisition channels currently operates.

Within 3 months, you will

  • Fully own a portfolio of channels and campaigns to optimise in line with our performance guidelines

  • Work to automate campaign and creative optimisation process

  • Improve our usage of custom audience strategies across all channels

Within 6 months, you will

  • Scale your portfolio to reach our strategic growth objectives

  • Seek opportunities to further improve our growth operations by deploying AI tools

  • Assist in developing our retargeting workflows for a more diversified approach

The recruitment process

  • First call with Nicolas, Talent Acquisition

  • An interview with Janos, our Growth Director

  • Technical test / case study.

  • Fit interviews

  • And if everything goes well, an offer !

What we offer

  • A highly competitive salary range as well as equity in the company

  • A highly flexible remote work policy, 2 days at the office per month, with monthly team events.

  • We also cover fees for external professional events and meetups (Android Makers, etc…)

  • Great health insurance coverage for both you and your family by Alan, fully paid for by Yubo !

  • Numerous benefits for parents: additional parental leave, easy access to nurseries and daycare facilities in France.

Our approach to privacy & safety

As part of your role, you may handle tools and features involving personal data. We expect all employees to demonstrate strong awareness of privacy and safety issues, and to actively support our Privacy & Safety by Design efforts.

Join Yubo and help shape the future of Social Discovery while enjoying a culture that values flexibility, well-being, and impact.

 

Here’s how we live our mission every day:

You own the impact: Step up, adapt, and make it matter

Unconventionally Smart: Hack with intent, borrow smart, build better

Be Bold & Resilient: Raise your head, break barriers, keep moving forward

One team, one mission: No egos, no passengers, just shared wins

 

Trust & Flexibility: Our hybrid model calls for only two office days a month; the rest is up to the rhythm that works best for you.

 

Enjoy Top-notch Benefits

Culture is central at Yubo, hence the numerous benefits:

Cool Workplace: enjoy our amazing Parisian office and our many hybrid work options

  • Own the agent stack end-to-end. Context engineering, tool design, evals, tracing, cost. You're responsible for whether the agent works in production.

  • Make ClickStack a great place to run AI workloads. Build the MCP servers, SDKs, and integrations that let customers' agents read telemetry, take action, and stay observable themselves.

  • Work in the open. Collaborate with OSS contributors and customers, debug their problems alongside them, and feed what you learn back into the product.

Who you are

  • You think in production terms: p99 latency, cost per task, whether the system still works next week without intervention.

  • You move quickly, ship often, and learn from what breaks.

title: Principal of backend
description:
About SchemeServe

SchemeServe is insurance software like no other.

Hosted in the cloud for MGAs, brokers and insurers, the SchemeServe platform boasts unique flexibility, unstoppable innovation and truly Obsessive Support.

Started in 2000 by our CEO, Adam, SchemeServe has grown from strength to strength, never having taken outside investment. We're proud of how far we've come and how loyal we've stayed to our Core Values.

We're fully remote (we were doing it before it was fashionable!), although we get together twice a year for Team Retreats.

We prize self-development and encourage everyone to keep learning and challenging themselves. Free books? Mentoring? Professional development? You got it.

We also offer flexible working, paid charity days, a fantastic, relaxed and open company culture and free biscuits through the post.

We genuinely believe this is the best place you could ever work.

If you're excited, good! So are we.

Come and join the Insurtech revolution!

Principal Backend Engineer

UK Remote

We're looking for an exceptional Principal Backend Engineer to help make backend engineering across SchemeServe better.

You'll be one of the most technically experienced engineers in the organisation and the CTO's primary technical partner for backend engineering, helping shape our architecture, engineering principles and technical direction.

But this isn't primarily a feature delivery role and your job isn't to personally build everything you help design.

Your real job is to make our engineering organisation better at building great software.

You'll work alongside engineers and teams, helping solve difficult problems, challenging their thinking and developing their technical skills and judgement.

What We Mean By Principal

This is a deeply technical role.

You'll need the depth to understand complex backend systems, architecture, security, performance, resilience and maintainability; review designs and implementations; spot risks; and challenge experienced engineers.

But technical knowledge alone isn't enough.

We want someone who understands there isn't always one "correct" way to build software.

Patterns, standards and best practices are useful tools. They aren't commandments.

We care about finding the most appropriate solution to the problem in front of us.

That means understanding the problem, business, existing platform, risks and likely future – and making pragmatic decisions based on the trade-offs.

Sometimes the right answer will be a new service or technology.

Sometimes it'll be improving what we already have.

Sometimes the boring solution really is the best solution.

We're quite comfortable with that.

How You'll Lead

Success in this role comes through influence rather than authority.

We don't want every difficult technical decision to end with:

"We'd better ask the Principal Engineer."

If an engineer proposes an approach you disagree with, we don't just want you to replace it with your own.

Understand their thinking. Ask questions. Challenge assumptions. Explore the trade-offs. Share your experience.

And be prepared to change your own mind too.

The goal is to leave that engineer better equipped to solve the next problem, not just holding the answer to this one.

Your technical impact should multiply through the people around you.

You'll remain close enough to the code to understand what's actually happening and occasionally roll up your sleeves to prototype, investigate a difficult problem or unblock a team.

But if after a year you've personally written loads of brilliant software while everyone around you is working exactly as they were before, we haven't succeeded.

The Technical Challenge

Our platform has been evolving for more than 25 years.

At its heart is a mature C# .NET Framework 4.7 monolith, alongside an expanding ecosystem of modern C# .NET 10 and TypeScript services.

Our backend estate includes:

  • .NET Framework and modern C#/.NET.
  • TypeScript services.
  • Microsoft SQL Server, PostgreSQL and Redis.
  • Azure cloud infrastructure.
  • Cloudflare platform services.
  • API-first architecture.
  • Git-based development workflows.

We're continuing to modernise, but we're not interested in modernisation for modernisation's sake.

We aren't trying to win an award for having the most fashionable architecture diagram.

We want a secure, reliable and maintainable platform that can support SchemeServe for many years to come – and we want you to help us decide what should evolve and, just as importantly, what doesn't need changing.

What You'll Do

You'll work closely with our CTO and engineering teams to:

  • Shape our backend engineering strategy, architecture and technical direction.
  • Help engineers make better technical and architectural decisions.
  • Develop sensible engineering principles and guardrails without replacing good judgement with rules.
  • Guide the continued evolution of our monolith and modern service-based platform.
  • Coach and mentor engineers, developing their technical skills and judgement.
  • Review significant designs and architectural decisions and challenge unnecessary complexity.
  • Champion security, quality, testing, observability, resilience and performance.
  • Identify technical risks and help teams navigate them.
  • Evaluate technologies and patterns based on their value to SchemeServe rather than their popularity elsewhere.
  • Balance long-term engineering quality with short-term business needs.
  • Occasionally contribute directly to implementation when that's genuinely the best way to help.
  • Be a generally awesome person.

What We're Looking For

You'll need:

  • Deep expertise in modern backend engineering and strong commercial C#/.NET experience.
  • Strong knowledge of software architecture, distributed systems and API design.
  • Experience with mature legacy applications and modern service-oriented architectures.
  • Strong cloud architecture experience, ideally Azure.
  • Excellent understanding of databases, security, testing, maintainability and modern software delivery.
  • Experience shaping engineering principles and practices across teams.
  • A track record of making engineers around you better through mentoring, coaching and technical leadership.
  • The ability to challenge experienced engineers constructively without becoming a gatekeeper.
  • Strong opinions, loosely held – the confidence to challenge and the humility to change your mind.
  • Excellent communication and the ability to influence without relying on authority.
  • Excellent technical judgement, balancing quality, complexity, risk, cost and business value.

Most importantly, we're looking for someone who asks:

"What's the right solution for us?"

rather than:

"What's the way everyone else is doing it?"

Nice To Have

  • Experience modernising large monolithic applications.
  • Commercial TypeScript backend experience.
  • Cloudflare or edge technology experience.
  • SaaS platforms at scale.
  • Financial services, insurance or another regulated industry.
  • Observability, platform engineering or SRE experience.
  • AI-assisted development and engineering productivity tooling.

You don't need to tick every box.

If you've got the technical depth, judgement and ability to make engineers around you better, we'd rather have a conversation than lose a great candidate because you haven't used one particular technology.

What Success Looks Like

Within your first year:

  • Engineers are making stronger technical and architectural decisions with greater confidence.
  • Our engineering principles are understood rather than blindly followed.
  • Technical discussions are constructive, pragmatic and result in clear decisions.
  • Security, reliability, maintainability and performance concerns are identified earlier.
  • We've made sensible progress modernising our platform without adding complexity for complexity's sake.
  • You've made a lasting positive impact on both our software and the people who build it.

Ultimately, we don't want SchemeServe to become dependent on you for every difficult technical decision.

We want SchemeServe to become better at making those decisions because you're here.

Why Join SchemeServe?

  • Fully remote UK-based role.
  • Twice-yearly company retreats.
  • Flexible working.
  • Dedicated professional development support.
  • Paid charity days.

Friendly, supportiv...

description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We're looking for a Data Scientist - Product Analytics to join our Growth Data team. You'll own the analysis behind how people discover, adopt and stick with ElevenLabs' products, partnering closely with Product, Growth and the central Data team's certified metrics layer.

  • Define and own product health metrics: activation, feature adoption, retention and engagement across ElevenCreative, ElevenAgents and ElevenAPI.

  • Design, analyse and communicate the results of product experiments (A/B tests, feature launches, onboarding changes).

  • Partner with Analytics Engineering on the certified product KPI layer in dbt, and with Product on turning ambiguous questions into trusted analysis.

  • Work alongside fellow Growth data scientists on marketing- and revenue-adjacent questions that touch the product funnel.

Requirements

Demonstrated experience as a data scientist embedded with a product or growth team, ideally at a product-led company.

  • Strong SQL and Python, with hands-on experience in experimentation (A/B testing) and product analytics.

  • Ability to translate ambiguous product questions into clear, reusable analysis and defensible metrics.

  • Comfort working directly with Product and Growth stakeholders, and pushing back on ill-defined asks.

  • Structured thinker who can move fast without sacrificing rigour.

Bonus

  • Experience with activation / retention modelling or lifecycle analytics at a consumer or prosumer product.

  • Experience with dbt or a modern warehouse, partnering directly with analytics engineers.

  • Experience using AI tools or agents to speed up analysis or enable self-serve data access.

Growth potential

We believe in hiring the best talent in the world to make an impact in the right role at the right time. At ElevenLabs, strong performance creates opportunities for growth. Here are some of the career paths you can expect after excelling in this role:

  • Grow into a Senior or Staff Product Data Scientist role as the Growth Data team scales.

  • Expand scope across additional product lines (ElevenAgents, ElevenAPI).

  • Path into a Growth Data Science lead or broader data leadership track.

title: Senior Product Engineer
description:
Grow with Treefera

We are a first-mile intelligence platform, delivering granular visibility into the point of origin in global ag & soft commodity supply chains - where risk, cost, performance and exposure are set.

You’ll join a global, cross-functional team that values rigour, curiosity and working close to real-world challenges. Whether your focus is AI, climate, product or operations, you’ll have space to contribute meaningfully and make an impact from day one.

If you’re excited by complex problems and want to help reshape how nature is valued in real-world decision-making, we’d love to hear from you.

Role overview

Treefera is hiring a Senior Full Stack Engineer to strengthen delivery capacity in Environmental Intelligence at a point where the team needs greater resilience, broader end-to-end ownership, and faster iteration across product, platform and customer-facing outcomes. You're polyglot by instinct — Python is your primary language, but you're not constrained by it, and you reach for whatever the problem and Treefera's existing platform demand. This role exists to turn ambiguous ideas into shipped software across UI, API and pipeline work, solving problems independently and working within existing platform constraints and architecture, while helping the team improve how it builds, documents and scales what works.

Your work will help Treefera ship impactful product improvements faster and turn promising ideas into usable outcomes.

Who you are

  • You are a polyglot engineer with deep expertise in Python as your primary language, and the range and judgement to pick up whatever language, framework or tool the problem calls for — you are not constrained to a single stack.

  • You solve problems without needing guidance: given an ambiguous brief, you make sensible default decisions, fill in the gaps yourself, and get on with the work rather than waiting for perfect structure.

  • You communicate your thinking clearly, document approaches well, and collaborate constructively through feedback and code review.

  • You know how to fit your solutions into existing platform constraints and architecture, extending and evolving systems thoughtfully rather than defaulting to a rewrite.

  • You thrive in a fast-moving startup environment where priorities can shift quickly, delivery pace matters, and you're trusted to set your own direction within it.

  • You use AI productively in development and can clearly explain your choices, trade-offs and outputs.

Desirable requirements (if applicable):

  • Experience with geospatial data, GIS, remote sensing or Earth Observation.

  • Familiarity with Postgres and PostGIS.

  • Experience across data pipelines, Python APIs, database management, and application or visualisation work.

  • Exposure to scientific Python tooling such as NumPy, GeoPandas or Xarray.

  • Familiarity with other languages and frameworks such as Typescript, React, or NestJS — you pick up what the codebase needs rather than sticking to one stack.

What the job involves

  • Build and maintain software across user interfaces, APIs and supporting pipelines → delivering usable product outcomes end to end.

  • Turn emerging ideas into MVPs and proof-of-concepts quickly → enabling faster customer feedback and iteration toward product–market fit.

  • Own implementation and architectural decisions within your scope, working within and evolving Treefera's existing platform constraints and architecture → helping the team move with speed under ambiguity.

  • Support work beyond release through maintenance, documentation and operational follow-through → improving reliability and adoption.

  • Contribute to how engineering works across the wider team through code review, mentoring and practical tooling improvements → raising quality and effectiveness over time.

  • Demo and enable work so that product progress translates into commercial and customer impact → helping strong technical work land successfully.

What success looks like

In your first phase, you will build enough context to deliver meaningful end-to-end work into production, including ambiguous problems that require judgement rather than tightly defined tickets. As you become established, you will contribute beyond your immediate pod through stronger code review, documentation, tooling or process improvements that make delivery more effective. Over time, success will be visible in the quality of your unprompted contributions: better ways of working, smarter technical decisions, and product or platform improvements that help Treefera ship faster, respond better, and create stronger outcomes for customers.

Interview process & what to expect

Recruiter screen (30–45 min)

Hiring manager & Collaborative technical session (45-60 min)

Final cross-functional or executive conversation (If applicable). (30-45 min)

Accessibility: Tell us if you need adjustments, we’ll accommodate.

What you’ll gain at Treefera

  • Build something that matters - join a high-growth climate-tech company applying AI, satellite data and quantitative modelling to real-world challenges across global supply chains, commodities and carbon.

  • Work on complex, meaningful problems - develop systems that balance risk, resilience, compliance and sustainability, giving organisations a genuine information advantage at global scale.

  • Collaborate with exceptional people - work alongside scientists, engineers and operators who are leaders in their fields, combining academic rigour with practical, cross-functional product delivery.

  • Ship and grow in a high-trust environment - experiment, iterate and take thoughtful risks in a team that values autonomy, creativity and continuous learning.

  • Develop your craft - dedicated space and time to grow your skills toward mastery, tackling technically demanding challenges that push the boundaries of applied AI and environmental data.

  • Be rewarded for your impact - competitive compensation, equity options, meaningful benefits, and the opportunity to help shape the future of AI-powered risk and environmental intelligence.

Diversity, Equity & Inclusion

Bold solutions come from diverse teams. Please refer to our DEI & EEO commitment below. If you need any accommodation during the application process, we’re here to support you.

Learn more about how we think and build

Many of our engineers, scientists and product leaders share their thinking publicly. Explore the Treefera blog for technical deep dives, research and product perspectives.

Privacy notice

By applying to Treefera, you consent to the processing of your personal data in line with our Privacy Notice.

Treefera is an equal opportunity employer. We believe the diversity of our people is as vital as the diversity of the ecosystems we work to protect, and we are committed to building an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds irrespective of race, colour, ethnicity, national origin, religion, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, pregnancy, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.
