title: Tech Lead - AI & Innovation
description:
Vicoland gives the professional services market a new dimension: Virtual Companies – "Vicos". We invented Vicos as a new type of supplier, more efficient than traditional professional services firms (consultancies, system integrators, agencies etc.). We have received 20 million € in round A financing.

Vicos may consist of freelancers, SMEs and AI agents. They organize through our AI-driven SaaS platform to act like real companies, competing successfully for large enterprise projects, e g. ERP introductions or AI transformations. Vicos have proven to be more cost-efficient and to deliver better quality than traditional companies.

Already, 120+ Vicos with thousands of freelancers work on projects for enterprise clients like BASF, Miele, Siemens or Daimler and many SME. Forbes and Forrester have named Vicoland as a leading force transforming the market.

Our certified platform is key to our success. It provides the full digital infrastructure which makes Vicos come true as a new form to organize human labor and human-agentic interaction. It covers end-to-end all essential areas: marketing, finance, legal, and organization.

Given its ambitious and transformative purpose, our platform is highly complex (though easy use). Developing it further takes engineers who combine technical excellence, pragmatic judgement and entrepreneurial spirit. The Tech Lead: AI & Innovation we are looking for embodies these qualities in his or her leadership. He or she is up for making a major contribution to our company and to our society.

Tasks

  • You will lead, grow and enable a team of (forward deployed) engineers: make every engineer successful in their role and hire new ones who strengthen the team.
  • You will be the only (and main) tech lead for the engineering team, with carreer option to progress to CTO
  • Own the technical direction and technology decisions for Vicoland. Set the architecture across the stack, from frontend to infrastructure, and make sure what we build is scalable, robust and maintainable.
  • Stay hands-on: contribute features yourself end-2-end by understanding business needs, coding, building prototypes, and for all that using AI to aggressively ship high-quality software alongside your team.
  • Translate business needs into technical roadmaps in close cooperation with Business Development, Product and other stakeholders. Prioritize, scope and make trade-offs explicit.
  • Makre sure each team member can work end-to-end: concept & design, development, QA, deployment and production monitoring, with clear engineering standards and quality gates.
  • Continuously improve how we build with AI: best practices for context engineering, model selection, evaluation, tracing and observability, so that quality is measured, not assumed.
  • Run architectural discussions, code reviews and retrospectives; create a culture of ownership, constructive challenge and continuous learning.
  • Act as a sparring partner to the Chief Product Officer and the business leadership team on technology strategy, build-vs-buy decisions and team setup.

Requirements

  • Have proven people leadership experience: you have led an engineering team (ideally 3+ engineers), including hiring, performance evaluations, career development and coaching.
  • Have excelled somewhere through an impactful technical contribution, one which we can talk about, and still enjoy writing code yourself.
  • Have deep hands-on experience across the stack (frontend, backend, data, infrastructure/cloud) and a track record of architecting and shipping production-grade software, preferably with AI components (LLMs, embeddings, RAG pipelines, autonomous agents, PyTorch/TensorFlow).
  • Have experience developing AI agents and integrating them into business workflows.
  • Be on top of the latest tools, models and trends in AI-assisted software engineering. You are excellent at context engineering (incl. prompting), know when to leverage which model, and have first-hand experience with Claude Code or Cursor, and you know how to roll these practices out across a team.
  • Know how to evaluate what gets built. You can design eval sets, work with LLM-as-judge or ground-truth data, use tracing and observability tooling to find and fix regressions, and make evaluation a team habit.
  • Practice a truly agnostic approach to stack and tools: you pick the right tech for the problem, not vice versa, and can explain your choices to both engineers and business stakeholders.
  • Balance autonomy and alignment: you drive your team from idea to finished product independently, while knowing when to involve, align with or escalate to others.
  • Have the ability to thoughtfully challenge ideas and drive constructive discussions with users, engineers, product, and business leadership.
  • Lead with humility: you create psychological safety, give and receive honest feedback, and measure your success by the success of your team.
  • Reside within ±3 hours of Central European Time (to enable effective collaboration), at best in one of our office locations in Barcelona, Berlin, Frankfurt, Leipzig, and Sevilla.
  • Full professional proficiency in English at C2 level.
  • Full professional proficiency in German at C1 level.

Bonus Qualifications

  • Experience building or scaling an engineering team in a startup or scale-up environment.
  • Prior experience integrating AI into SaaS business workflows, ideally in a client-facing or forward-deployed setup.
  • Familiarity with the modern AI-tooling ecosystem (agents, memory systems, vector databases, orchestration frameworks).
  • Experience working with distributed or multi-location teams.

Benefits

  • You’ll work in an international, closely knit team of high‑performers and entrepreneurial spirits.
  • Remote‑friendly + flexible work hours.
  • Excellent compensation + participation in the company through our ESOP.
  • Growth mindset: Hard skills are important — but mindset matters more. If you meet most of the requirements and you’re hungry to learn, apply anyway.

If you’re a high‑impact tech lead who thrives on autonomy, drives real results, and is passionate about applying AI to change how teams work - let’s talk. Even if you don’t check every bullet above, but you bring exceptional drive, creativity, and a growth mindset, please apply. We believe the right mindset counts more than checkboxes.

description:
About Us

At Axle Energy, we’re building the infrastructure that will underpin the decarbonised energy system. Our software moves energy usage to times when electricity is cheap and green, by controlling vehicle charging, heating systems, and home batteries. We control hundreds of thousands of energy assets.

We’re building in a legacy industry and moving gigawatt-hours of electrons in the real world, but we operate at lightning speed, and we’re growing the team to meet customer demand.

We’re proud to be supported by world-leading investors, including Energize Capital and Accel.

Read more about what we’re building here.

 

About the role

Solutions Engineers at Axle build the integrations and technical infrastructure that enable our customers to connect distributed energy devices, orchestrate them, and participate in electricity markets.

This is a generalist engineering role, encompassing core software engineering, customer implementation, and solution design. You will work closely with our customers to understand their technical requirements, build integrations, solve complex technical challenges, and help shape our product based on real world feedback.

We encourage engineers to own as much of the problem space as they can. You will spend time talking to customers, getting feedback from users, and working closely with market operators, while collaborating with Product to deliver scalable engineering solutions.

At Axle, we work in a deliberately flat structure. That means fewer layers, faster decisions, and more ownership for everyone.

 

Solutions Engineering at Axle looks like

  • Forming a deep understanding of our domain, our platform, and our customers' technical challenges, so you have enough context to execute at speed.

  • Building and maintaining integrations with customer systems, distributed energy devices, and third-party platforms.

  • Working closely with customers to troubleshoot technical issues, support implementations, and design scalable solutions.

  • Steering customers towards a more direct launch plan and a better user experience.

  • Collaborating closely with our Product team to turn customer feedback into product improvements.

  • Focus on outcomes rather than process, taking ownership of the quality and impact of the final product you deliver.

  • Manage your own time and support others to adapt to changing scope and deadlines, to deliver 80% of the value in 20% of the time

 

Tech stack

🐍 We build in Python + React for the frontend

🐋 Everything we build lives in Docker, for minimal cross-platform faff and maximal reproducibility.
🤖 Unlimited Claude Code tokens - we are aggressive users and explorers of AI, and encourage everybody to reconsider their workflows regularly

☁️ We deploy on GCP

What's in it for you

A meaningful slice of equity in Axle, alongside a competitive salary, with total compensation ranging from £75k–£200k (base salary + equity).

We operate with a deliberately flat structure and aim to keep pay equitable across the company, with a 1:1 median ratio between founder and team compensation.

Enhanced parental leave to support you through life's meaningful moments.

Bi-annual retreats to strengthen team connection & shared purpose.

Hybrid working - We have a dog-friendly office around Farringdon. To maximize collaboration, we ask that you spend 2-3 days a week in the office.

The opportunity to directly shape the future of energy markets and accelerate the transition to a low-carbon world.

 

We are extremely keen to build a diverse company, and we’re particularly eager to hear from candidates who don't fit the traditional role stereotypes. If you’re motivated by our mission, please do reach out, even if you feel you might not ‘check all the boxes’.

 

Interview process

  1. Initial interview

  2. Remote pair programming

  3. Final interview (in-person)

  4. Offer, references, and welcome to the team!

About Us

At Axle Energy, we’re building the infrastructure that will underpin the decarbonised energy system. Our software moves energy usage to times when electricity is cheap and green, by controlling vehicle charging, heating systems, and home batteries. We control hundreds of thousands of energy assets.

We’re building in a legacy industry and moving gigawatt-hours of electrons in the real world, but we operate at lightning speed, and we’re growing the team to meet customer demand.

We’re proud to be supported by world-leading investors, including Energize Capital and Accel.

Read more about what we’re building here.

 

About the role

Software Engineers at Axle build the core infrastructure for connecting to distributed energy devices, orchestrating them, and allowing them to participate in electricity markets.

This is a generalist Software Engineering role, encompassing product-engineering, devops, and data engineering. We encourage engineers to own as much of the problem-space as they can: you’ll spend time talking to clients, getting feedback from users, and working closely with market operators.

At Axle, we work in a deliberately flat structure. That means fewer layers, faster decisions, and more ownership for everyone.

Software engineering at Axle looks like

  • Forming a deep understanding of the domain & the business, so you have enough context to execute independently at speed

  • Focusing on outcomes, not process, and taking ownership for the end product you ship into the world

  • Managing your own time and those of others to adapt to changing scope and deadlines, delivering 80% of the value in 20% of the time

Tech stack

🐍 We build in Python + React for the frontend

🐋 Everything we build lives in Docker, for minimal cross-platform faff and maximal reproducibility.
🤖 Unlimited Claude Code tokens - we are aggressive users and explorers of AI, and encourage everybody to reconsider their workflows regularly

☁️ We deploy on GCP

What's in it for you

A meaningful slice of equity in Axle, alongside a competitive salary, with total compensation ranging from £75k–£200k (base salary + equity).

We operate with a deliberately flat structure and aim to keep pay equitable across the company, with a 1:1 median ratio between founder and team compensation.

Enhanced parental leave to support you through life's meaningful moments.

Bi-annual retreats to strengthen team connection & shared purpose.

Hybrid working - We have a dog-friendly office around Farringdon. To maximize collaboration, we ask that you spend 2-3 days a week in the office.

The opportunity to directly shape the future of energy markets and accelerate the transition to a low-carbon world.

We are extremely keen to build a diverse company, and we’re particularly eager to hear from candidates who don't fit the traditional role stereotypes. If you’re motivated by our mission, please do reach out, even if you feel you might not ‘check all the boxes’.

Interview process

  1. Initial interview

  2. Remote pair programming

  3. Final interview (in-person)

  4. Offer, references, and welcome to the team!

Compensation: £75K – £200K

  • • Total Compensation (salary + equity) £75K – £200K

title: Senior Product Engineer
description:
Grow with Treefera

We are a first-mile intelligence platform, delivering granular visibility into the point of origin in global ag & soft commodity supply chains - where risk, cost, performance and exposure are set.

You’ll join a global, cross-functional team that values rigour, curiosity and working close to real-world challenges. Whether your focus is AI, climate, product or operations, you’ll have space to contribute meaningfully and make an impact from day one.

If you’re excited by complex problems and want to help reshape how nature is valued in real-world decision-making, we’d love to hear from you.

Role overview

Build the systems behind Treefera's Environmental Intelligence — the data models, pipelines and APIs that turn satellite and ground-truth signals into evidence customers can act on, fast enough to change a decision.

Who you are

  • You have taken a production Python service or pipeline through a significant change to its architecture — a re-model, a re-platform, or a rewrite of how data moves through it.

  • You design the data models and APIs other people build on, and you have lived with the consequences of your own schema decisions.

  • You work from a problem rather than a ticket: you pick the approach, make the call on the trade-offs, and can explain the reasoning afterwards.

  • You extend systems that already exist — including the parts nobody wants to touch — rather than reaching for a rewrite.

  • You use AI in your workflow, or are ready to, and you can explain what you kept, what you threw away, and why.

Desirable requirements (if applicable):

  • Geospatial or Earth Observation data — GIS, remote sensing, or Postgres and PostGIS.

  • Scientific Python such as NumPy, GeoPandas or Xarray, or pipeline orchestration with Dagster.

  • Some familiarity with Typescript, React or NestJS — you will touch the app occasionally rather than daily.

What the job involves

  • Ship services end to end — data model, pipeline, API — from a question a customer asked to something that answers it.

  • Turn emerging ideas into working prototypes quickly, so customer feedback arrives in weeks rather than quarters.

  • Own the technical decisions in your scope — extending Treefera's existing platform and its constraints, refactoring where it pays and resisting the rewrite where it doesn't.

  • Carry work past release through maintenance, documentation and operational follow-through, so what ships stays reliable.

  • Improve how the team builds through code review, mentoring less experienced engineers, and practical tooling improvements.

  • Land the work commercially — demo what you build and enable the people who sell and support it, so what you build gets adopted, not just shipped.

What success looks like

Within 30 days you will have shipped something small into production and know where the platform's edges and legacy corners are. By 60 days you will own a piece of Environmental Intelligence end to end — data model through pipeline to API — including the problems that arrive as open questions rather than tickets. By 90 days it is released and customers are querying it, sharpening the evidence organisations use to protect forests and de-risk supply chains. By six months your work shows up beyond your pod, in the documentation, tooling and standards that make everyone quicker. Within a year, environmental evidence reaches the people who need it faster, and your work is a visible part of that.

Who you’ll work with

You’ll join the Engineering team and partner day-to-day with Product, Customer Solutions and the Science/AI team, while working closely with HQ teams (Operations, Finance, Legal) and our enterprise customers.

Interview process & what to expect

Recruiter screen (30–45 min)

Hiring manager & Collaborative technical session (45-60 min)

Final cross-functional or executive conversation (If applicable). (30-45 min)

Accessibility: Tell us if you need adjustments, we’ll accommodate.

What you’ll gain at Treefera

  • Build something that matters - join a high-growth climate-tech company applying AI, satellite data and quantitative modelling to real-world challenges across global supply chains, commodities and carbon.

  • Work on complex, meaningful problems - develop systems that balance risk, resilience, compliance and sustainability, giving organisations a genuine information advantage at global scale.

  • Collaborate with exceptional people - work alongside scientists, engineers and operators who are leaders in their fields, combining academic rigour with practical, cross-functional product delivery.

  • Ship and grow in a high-trust environment - experiment, iterate and take thoughtful risks in a team that values autonomy, creativity and continuous learning.

  • Develop your craft - dedicated space and time to grow your skills toward mastery, tackling technically demanding challenges that push the boundaries of applied AI and environmental data.

  • Be rewarded for your impact - competitive compensation, equity options, meaningful benefits, and the opportunity to help shape the future of AI-powered risk and environmental intelligence.

Diversity, Equity & Inclusion

Bold solutions come from diverse teams. Please refer to our DEI & EEO commitment below. If you need any accommodation during the application process, we’re here to support you.

Learn more about how we think and build

Many of our engineers, scientists and product leaders share their thinking publicly. Explore the Treefera blog for technical deep dives, research and product perspectives.

Privacy notice

By applying to Treefera, you consent to the processing of your personal data in line with our Privacy Notice.

Treefera is an equal opportunity employer. We believe the diversity of our people is as vital as the diversity of the ecosystems we work to protect, and we are committed to building an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds irrespective of race, colour, ethnicity, national origin, religion, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, pregnancy, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Reasonable accommodations are available upon request.

title: AI & Platform Innovation Engineer
description:
Vicoland gives the professional services market a new dimension: Virtual Companies – "Vicos". We invented Vicos as a new type of supplier, more efficient than traditional professional services firms (consultancies, system integrators, agencies etc.). We have received 20 million € in round A financing.

Vicos may consist of freelancers, SMEs and AI agents. They organize through our AI-driven SaaS platform to act like real companies, competing successfully for large enterprise projects, e g. ERP introductions or AI transformations. Vicos have proven to be more cost-efficient and to deliver better quality than traditional companies.

Already, 120+ Vicos with thousands of freelancers work on projects for enterprise clients like BASF, Miele, Siemens or Daimler and many SME. Forbes and Forrester have named Vicoland as a leading force transforming the market.

Our certified platform is key to our success. It provides the full digital infrastructure which makes Vicos come true as a new form to organize human labor and human-agentic interaction. It covers end-to-end all essential areas: marketing, finance, legal, and organization.

Given its ambitious and transformative purpose, our platform is highly complex (though easy use). Developing it further takes engineers who combine technical excellence, pragmatic judgement and entrepreneurial spirit. The AI & Platform Innovation Engineer we are looking for embodies these qualities. He or she is up for making a major contribution to our company and to our society.

Tasks

  • Develop AI-agentic solutions from scratch or integrating existing agents and foundational technologies. This involves close cooperation with our Business Development team and other users.
  • Use AI to aggressively ship high-quality code. Architect and build AI‑first software solutions for complex user‑stories: scalable, robust, maintainable.
  • Work closely with stakeholders to deliver end‑to‑end innovations.
  • Own the full development pipeline: from design and development, through QA and deployment, to production monitoring.
  • Lead architectural discussions, code reviews, and retrospectives; mentor fellow engineers.
  • Champion AI‑powered features: integrate LLMs, RAG pipelines, agentic workflows, embeddings and deep learning frameworks to unlock business value.

Requirements

  • Have excelled somewhere, somehow through an impacting technical contribution — one which we can talk about.
  • Have experience in developing AI agents and integrating them into workflows.
  • Be on top of the latest tools, models and trends in AI-assisted software engineering. We expect you to be amazing at context engineering (incl. prompting), to know when to leverage different models, and to have first-hand experience with Claude Code or Cursor.
  • Know how to evaluate what you build. You can design eval sets, work with LLM-as-judge or ground-truth data, and use tracing and observability tooling to find and fix regressions.
  • Have hands‑on record of building production‑grade software, preferably with AI components (LLMs, embeddings, PyTorch/TensorFlow, RAG pipelines, autonomous agents).
  • Practice a truly agnostic approach to stack and tools: you pick the right tech for the problem — not vice‑versa.
  • Show exceptional autonomy: your are able to self‑drive from idea to finished product, yet know when to collaborate and escalate.
  • Have the ability to thoughtfully challenge ideas and drive constructive discussions (colleagues, product owners, CTO).
  • Be a strong, respectful team player: highly autonomous but grounded in humility and partnership.
  • Reside within ±3 hours of Central European Time (to enable effective collaboration), at best in one of our office locations in Barcelona, Berlin, Frankfurt, Leipzig, and Sevilla.
  • Full professional proficiency in English at C2 level

Bonus

  • Prior experience integrating AI into SaaS business workflows.
  • Familiarity with modern AI‑tooling ecosystem (agents, memory systems, vector databases).
  • Experience leading a tech team or architecting across the stack — from frontend to infrastructure.
  • Professional proficiency in German.

Benefits

  • You’ll work in an international, closely knit team of high‑performers and entrepreneurial spirits.
  • Remote‑friendly + flexible work hours.
  • Excellent compensation + participation in the company through our ESOP.
  • Growth mindset: Hard skills are important — but mindset matters more. If you meet most of the requirements and you’re hungry to learn, apply anyway.

If you’re a high‑impact engineer who thrives on autonomy, drives real results, and is passionate about applying AI to change how teams work — let’s talk. Even if you don’t check every bullet above, but you bring exceptional drive, creativity, and a growth mindset, please apply — we believe the right mindset counts more than checkboxes.

title: Site Reliability Engineer, Vehicle SW
description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About our Fleet Reliability Engineering Teams

Our Fleet Reliability Engineering team helps ensure the systems supporting Wayve’s autonomous vehicle operations are reliable, observable and scalable. Working across vehicle software, backend services, infrastructure, networking and fleet operations, the team tackles complex reliability challenges that span both cloud and vehicle-adjacent environments. You’ll collaborate closely with engineering and operations teams to improve resilience and help keep our vehicles operating safely and efficiently on public roads.

 

🧠 Your day-to-day

You’ll monitor live system health using logs, metrics, traces, alerts and reliability dashboards, identifying issues before they affect operations. When incidents occur, you’ll investigate them end to end—forming hypotheses, analysing data and driving problems through mitigation to root cause. You’ll participate in the on-call rotation, contribute to post-incident reviews and partner with teams across Wayve to prevent recurring failures.

 

🧩 What you’ll be working on

You’ll build tools and automation that reduce manual operational work and improve how quickly issues can be detected and resolved. This includes developing meaningful service-level indicators and objectives, improving monitoring and alerting, and creating automated checks and remediation workflows. You’ll also influence system design, turning recurring operational pain points into lasting improvements across software, infrastructure, networking and fleet operations.

 

🙌 You should apply if

You have hands-on experience in Site Reliability Engineering or a similar role supporting live production systems. You’re a strong programmer in Python, C++ or Rust, with solid Linux fundamentals and experience with cloud platforms, containers, Kubernetes and CI/CD. You understand observability practices and tools such as Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry or Splunk, and can explain concepts including SLIs, SLOs and error budgets. Most importantly, you’re comfortable debugging complex distributed systems across software, networking, operating systems and hardware-adjacent environments, and you bring a collaborative, detail-oriented approach to incident response and continuous improvement.

 

🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

 

More about Wayve:

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.

 

How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working:

Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives.

 

🔍 The Interview Process:

Our process is clear and respectful of your time:

  • Initial call / recruiter screen

  • Competency Interviews

  • Deep-dive technical interviews

  • Final interview:

We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability.

 

What’s in it for you (Location dependant):

💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually
📈 Meaningful equity, sharing in the ownership and long term success of Wayve
✈️ Relocation support and visa sponsorship where applicable
✅ Hybrid working, core hours and the chance to work hands on in vehicle workshops and labs
📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth
🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partnerships, team socials and more

A quick, honest note before you apply.

Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one.

If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you.

At Wayve we're committed to creating a diverse, fair and respectful culture that is inclusive of everyone based on their unique skills and perspectives, and regardless of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding) or any other basis as protected by applicable law.

For more information visit Careers at Wayve. To learn more about what drives us, visit Values at Wayve

DISCLAIMER: We will not ask about marriage or pregnancy, care responsibilities or disabilities in any of our job adverts or interviews. However, we do look to capture information about care responsibilities, and disabilities among other diversity information as part of an optional DEI Monitoring form to help us identify areas of improvement in our hiring process and ensure that the process is inclusive and non-discriminatory.

title: Principal Product Manager- Conversational AI
description:
About the Role

HTS Assist is Hopper's agentic AI assistant for travel, resolving real customer issues like flight changes, cancellations, refunds, and bookings over chat and voice for some of the largest travel brands and enterprises in the world. Voice carries its own product problems, from latency and turn-taking to escalation timing when a human is on the line, and this role owns both surfaces with equal depth.

As Principal Product Manager, you will own the customer-facing agent end to end: the conversations, the interface, and the experience our partners put in front of millions of travelers. This is a deliberately design-leaning role, and you will be the day-to-day design decision-maker, shaping flows and interfaces directly in close partnership with partner design teams and our in-house designer.

What would your day-to-day look like

  • Own the roadmap for the customer-facing conversational agent across chat and voice, from intent coverage and conversation design to the interfaces partners embed in their apps and websites

  • Set the product bar for voice specifically, covering latency, turn-taking, barge-in handling, localization, realtime voice and ASR/TTS quality, since a caller's tolerance for a bad interaction is lower than a chat user's

  • Engage enterprise partners through discovery, requirement shaping, and launch decisions, translating partner asks into product choices that keep one product serving many partners

  • Partner with Partner Solutions on implementation and onboarding

  • Drive design daily, working hands-on in Figma to produce flows and wireframes, and partner with design on high-fidelity and production assets

  • Build working prototypes using AI coding tools where they beat a written spec, to test conversation flows and interface ideas

  • Define and defend quality bars with the evaluation team, covering resolution rate, containment, escalation correctness, and conversation quality across both chat and voice

  • Specify agent behavior in detail, including resolution, tone, escalation policy, guardrails, and edge cases, and iterate from production conversation data

  • Stay close to GTM, Partner Solutions, and Success teams, feeding what the field learns back into the roadmap

     

An ideal candidate has

  • 8+ years of product management experience, including principal or lead-level ownership of a customer-facing product, with direct experience shipping voice-based conversational products such as IVR, voice bots, or contact center voice automation

  • Hands-on ownership of a production voice product, not only chat or text-based conversational AI, with working knowledge of ASR/TTS tradeoffs, latency budgets, and turn-taking or barge-in design. This is a required skillset

  • Design fluency, comfortable manipulating design files and producing flows and basic mocks solo in Figma, having operated as a de facto design lead on a lean team

  • The ability to write enough code to get a prototype working without waiting on an engineer, treating AI tools as a normal part of how they build

  • Hands-on front-end experience, having built or shipped web front ends and able to engage engineers credibly

  • Deep partner-facing experience with enterprise clients, ideally in regulated industries, shaping requirements and launch decisions at the product level

  • A data-driven approach grounded in customer service and automation metrics, including resolution, containment, CSAT, and escalation quality

  • Working familiarity with LLM-based products, including prompt and behavior design, AI quality practices, and their failure modes

Perks and benefits of working with us

  • Well-funded and proven startup with large ambitions, competitive salary, upsides of pre-IPO equity packages

  • Hopper covers 100% of the premiums for the employee for a group insurance plan through Vitality Health

  • Automatic contributions when you start with Hopper through Smart Pension

  • Please ask us about our very generous parental leave, much above industry standards

  • Access to co-working space on demand through FlexDesk and a work-from-home stipend

  • Carrot Cash travel stipend

  • Unlimited PTO

  • Entrepreneurial culture where pushing limits and taking risks is everyday business

  • Open communication with management and company leadership

  • Small, dynamic teams with massive impact

About Hopper
At Hopper, we are on a mission to become the leading travel platform globally, powering Hopper's mobile app, website and our B2B business, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions). By leveraging massive amounts of data and advanced machine learning algorithms, Hopper combines its world-class travel agency offering with proprietary fintech products to bring transparency, flexibility and savings to travelers globally. We have developed several unique fintech solutions that address everything from pricing volatility to trip disruptions, helping people travel better and save more on their trips.

The Hopper platform serves hundreds of millions of travelers globally and continues to capture market share around the world. The Hopper app has been downloaded over 120 million times and has become largely popular among younger travelers, with 70% of its users being Gen Z and millennials.

While many know us as the Gen Z and Millennial travel app, Hopper has evolved to become much more than that. In recent years, we've grown into a travel fintech provider, commerce platform, and global travel agency that powers some of the world's largest brands.

Through HTS, our B2B division, the company supercharges its partners' direct channels by integrating our fintech products on their sites or powering end-to-end travel portals. Today, our partners include leading travel brands like Capital One, Nubank, Air Canada, and many more.

Here are just a few stats that demonstrate the company's recent growth: billions of dollars worth of travel and travel fintech are sold through Hopper and HTS's channels every year. Our fintech products, including Cancel for Any Reason and Flight Disruption Assistance, have exceptionally strong CSAT because the terms are always clear and customers receive instant, no-questions-asked resolutions. Building the backbone of European trades together – with AI-first software.

Building AI-enabled products that work reliably at scale requires strong engineering foundations. You'll help shape those foundations — from architecture and system design to engineering practices — while keeping the focus on what we're ultimately building for our customers.

This is an individual contributor role with no disciplinary leadership but significant influence across Engineering. You'll work hands-on where it matters, shape technical direction across teams, and help other engineers build better systems.

  • AI-enabled product capabilities. You'll help define what AI can meaningfully do for our customers and turn emerging capabilities into reliable, observable product experiences that work beyond the demo.

How you'll work & influence

We have clear engineering principles, but we expect our Staff Engineers to challenge and evolve them. We favour small, integrated changes, observable systems that recover quickly, explicit architectural boundaries, and engineering decisions that are encoded rather than repeatedly debated. Above all, engineers own customer problems — not tickets.

You know what it takes to move these systems from promising demos into reliable product experiences, and you can help others build the judgement to use them safely.

  • Experience building and operating real production systems. You've designed, shipped, and lived with complex systems at scale — whether distributed architectures, asynchronous or multi-step workflows, event-driven services, data pipelines, or ETL pipelines. You understand reliability and observability because you've needed them in practice. You bring 5+ years of software engineering experience and a track record of technical leadership.

  • Strong typed-language fundamentals — and a polyglot mindset. You understand the concepts that make a strong type system valuable and use them to keep a growing codebase understandable and maintainable. Our stack is React on the frontend, serverless Node.js / Express on the backend, and GCP underneath — all TypeScript, so you're either productive in TypeScript or able to get there quickly. Where your deepest expertise sits matters less: if that's Rust, Go, Kotlin, or something else, we see it as a strength. Having worked across several languages and paradigms tends to reduce stack bias exactly when systems thinking matters most. Experience with another modern cloud environment is absolutely fine.

  • Information systems thinking. You distinguish clearly between operational data and knowledge — the transactional state that runs the business versus the modelled, contextual understanding that AI-enabled workflows depend on — and you design deliberately for both. In an agentic product, that distinction is a practical necessity, not a theoretical one.

  • Strong system design and domain modelling skills. You know how to create clear boundaries, model business concepts explicitly, and design systems that can evolve without every change becoming expensive. Techniques such as dependency injection, adapters, making invalid states unrepresentable, and parse-don’t-validate are tools you’ve applied rather than concepts you’ve only read about.

  • Strong product thinking. You start with the problem rather than the technology, use evidence to understand customer needs, and make deliberate trade-offs between technical excellence, speed, and product outcomes.

  • Technical leadership beyond your own work. You've influenced technical direction across teams, mentored other engineers, and can align Engineering, Product, and business stakeholders without relying on formal authority.

  • AI is already part of how you work. You use tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot, or Codex seriously, understand where they help and where they don't, and can help others adopt them effectively.

  • A T-shaped engineering profile. You bring broad engineering judgment across product and system challenges, with genuine depth in at least one area.

  • C1 English. German is a plus, not a must.

Deep production engineering experience and the ability to apply it to AI-enabled products matter more than expertise in a specific model or framework.

Who this role is for

This role is for someone who wants to operate as a senior individual contributor with broad technical influence — without people management. You won’t be the only Staff Engineer: we currently have four Staff Engineers and are looking for great additions to the group. You’ll work closely with Engineering Managers who steward people, team environment and flow while you steward the technical system and direction.

You’ll enjoy this role if you like moving across product, architecture, engineering practices and AI-enabled ways of working — and if you prefer shaping systems and standards across teams over specialising deeply in one narrow technology or domain.

WHY PLANCRAFT?

Energieversorger vertrauen uns ihre Abrechnungsdaten an. Deshalb ist Informationssicherheit bei uns Teil des Produkts. Für unser Büro in Berlin suchen wir eine:n Werkstudent:in ISMS & Compliance (m/w/d), der:die unser nach ISO/IEC 27001:2022 zertifiziertes ISMS mitgestaltet und weiterentwickelt.

Aufgaben

Deine Mission bei uns

Du sorgst mit dafür, dass die Plattform für die Energiewende sicher bleibt. Dabei lernst du Informationssicherheit so kennen, wie sie in einem wachsenden SaaS-Unternehmen tatsächlich gelebt wird.

  • Halte unser ISMS auditfest: Du unterstützt dabei, die Anforderungen der ISO/IEC 27001:2022 im Alltag umzusetzen und zu überprüfen. Du pflegst Richtlinien, Nachweise und Risikobewertungen und begleitest interne und externe Audits aus erster Reihe.
  • Mach Sicherheit messbar: Du definierst aussagekräftige KPIs für unser ISMS, erhebst sie möglichst automatisiert und machst sie in Dashboards sichtbar. Aus den Zahlen leitest du konkrete Verbesserungen ab.
  • Entwickle das ISMS weiter: Du bringst eigene Ideen ein, wie Prozesse schlanker, Kontrollen wirksamer und Dokumentation hilfreicher werden. Dein Ziel ist ein ISMS, das im Arbeitsalltag unterstützt und auch gelebt wird.
  • Sichere unsere Geräteflotte: Du gestaltest das Mobile Device Management unserer Firmengeräte aktiv mit, von Sicherheitsrichtlinien und Konfigurationsprofilen bis zum Rollout für mobile Geräte.
  • Gestalte Information Security im KI-Zeitalter: Du findest Antworten auf eine der spannendsten Fragen unserer Branche: Wie setzen wir KI-Tools produktiv ein und schützen gleichzeitig die Daten unserer Kunden zuverlässig? Dafür entwickelst du Richtlinien, Freigabeprozesse und technische Leitplanken, die Sicherheit und Effizienz verbinden.
  • Zusammenarbeit auf Augenhöhe: Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Engineering-Team und den Verantwortlichen für Informationssicherheit zusammen und übersetzt Sicherheitsanforderungen in praktikable Lösungen.

Qualifikation

Wir glauben fest daran, dass die richtige Einstellung und Motivation oft wichtiger sind als ein lückenloser Lebenslauf.

Das bringst du mit (Must-haves):

  • Studium mit Tech-Fokus: Du studierst Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik, (IT-)Sicherheit, Security Management oder einen vergleichbaren Studiengang, zum Beispiel an der TU Berlin, HTW, BHT oder am HPI in Potsdam.
  • Echtes Interesse an Informationssicherheit: Du hast erste Berührungspunkte gesammelt, etwa über Vorlesungen, Projekte, CTFs oder dein eigenes Homelab, und willst wissen, wie Security in der Praxis funktioniert.
  • Technisches Grundverständnis: Du verstehst, wie Cloud-Infrastruktur, Identitäts- und Zugriffsmanagement und Endgeräte zusammenspielen. Mit Python, Bash oder TypeScript automatisierst du wiederkehrende Aufgaben.
  • KI-gestützte Arbeitsweise: Du nutzt KI-Tools gezielt, prüfst ihre Ergebnisse kritisch und hast ein Gespür dafür, welche Daten in welches Tool gehören.
  • Struktur und Sorgfalt: Du arbeitest gewissenhaft, behältst auch bei vielen Anforderungen den Überblick und schreibst Dokumentation, die andere gerne lesen.
  • Zeit für uns: Du kannst 15–20 Stunden pro Woche in der Vorlesungszeit einplanen, idealerweise für mindestens 12 Monate.
  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse: Du kommunizierst sicher in beiden Sprachen, im Team ebenso wie mit Auditoren.

Pluspunkte sammelst du mit (Nice-to-haves):

  • Framework-Wissen: Du hast dich bereits mit ISO 27001, BSI IT-Grundschutz oder NIS2 beschäftigt.
  • Erfahrung mit Geräteverwaltung: Du hast schon mit MDM-Lösungen oder der Administration von Apple-Geräten gearbeitet.
  • Branchenwissen: Die Energiewende interessiert dich und du willst verstehen, wie die Daten hinter unserer Abrechnung funktionieren.

Benefits

Wir wollen nicht nur, dass du bei uns arbeitest - wir wollen, dass du mit uns wächst. Dein Wachstum & deine Karriere:

  • Steile Lernkurve: In direkter Zusammenarbeit mit einem erfahrenen Team kannst du dich schnell und nachhaltig weiterentwickeln.
  • Gestaltungsspielraum: Bringe deine eigenen Ideen ein und baue mit uns die Strukturen für unseren zukünftigen Erfolg auf.
  • Perspektive über das Studium hinaus: Wenn es für beide Seiten passt, hast du die Option, nach deinem Werkstudentenjob bei uns weiterzumachen.

Dein Arbeitsalltag:

  • Flexibilität, die zum Studium passt: Du verteilst deine Stunden flexibel auf die Woche, auch in kurzen Blöcken von wenigen Stunden pro Arbeitstag. So bleibt genug Raum für Vorlesungen und Prüfungen.
  • Berlin als Basis: Dein Arbeitsplatz ist unser Büro in Berlin. Dort arbeitest du regelmäßig mit dem Team zusammen. Ergänzend ist Remote Office möglich.

Unsere Kultur & unser Team:

  • Leidenschaft & Teamgeist: Wir sind ein passioniertes Team, das für seine Mission brennt und Erfolge gemeinsam feiert.
  • Regelmäßige Teamevents: Wir stärken unseren Zusammenhalt bei Events in Berlin, Stuttgart und an anderen Orten.

Bewirb dich jetzt und werde Teil unseres Teams bei Solarize!

title: Senior Java Backend Developer (gn)
description:
Schwerpunkt Microservices & DevOps · 100 % Remote innerhalb Deutschlands

Du entwickelst Backends, die auch bei komplexen Anforderungen zuverlässig funktionieren? Mit Java und Spring Boot fühlst du dich genauso wohl wie mit Microservices, automatisierten Deployments und sauberem Testing? Dann möchten wir dich kennenlernen.

Wir sind New Monday, eine remote arbeitende UX/UI-Agentur. Für den Ausbau unserer technischen Kompetenzen suchen wir erfahrene Unterstützung für anspruchsvolle Softwareprojekte im Umfeld der gesetzlichen Krankenversicherung. Dabei stehen sichere, skalierbare und wartbare Backend-Lösungen für digitale Anwendungen im Mittelpunkt.

Aufgaben

  • Du konzipierst, entwickelst und optimierst Java-Backends und Microservices mit Spring Boot.
  • Du gestaltest REST-APIs und eventbasierte Kommunikation zwischen verteilten Systemen.
  • Du übersetzt fachliche Anforderungen, Epics und User Stories in durchdachte technische Lösungen und berätst bei Architekturentscheidungen.
  • Du entwickelst bestehende Anwendungen weiter, refaktorierst Code und optimierst Datenzugriffe und Performance.
  • Du begleitest den Betrieb containerisierter Anwendungen auf OpenShift beziehungsweise Kubernetes und entwickelst CI/CD- und GitOps-Prozesse weiter.
  • Du setzt Sicherheitsanforderungen um, insbesondere für Authentifizierung, Autorisierung und Datenschutz.
  • Du sicherst die Softwarequalität durch automatisierte Tests, Code Reviews und systematische Fehleranalysen.
  • Du verbesserst Monitoring, Logging und Tracing und unterstützt bei Produktionseinführungen.
  • Du arbeitest eng mit Fachbereichen und technischen Teams zusammen, bringst dich in Workshops ein und dokumentierst deine Lösungen nachvollziehbar.

Qualifikation

  • Ein abgeschlossenes Studium im IT-Bereich oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.
  • Mindestens fünf Jahre praktische Erfahrung mit Java, Spring Boot, REST-APIs, Microservice-Architekturen und Unit-Testing sowie mit Git und Maven.
  • Mindestens drei Jahre Erfahrung mit OpenShift oder Kubernetes, GitLab CI/CD und automatisierter Auslieferung, beispielsweise mit Argo CD.
  • Mindestens drei Jahre Erfahrung mit relationalen Datenbanken wie PostgreSQL und mit Spring Data JPA.
  • Fundierte Erfahrung mit Testautomatisierung, Integrations- und Oberflächentests sowie Code Reviews. Werkzeuge wie Mockito, WireMock und Cucumber/Gherkin gehören zu deinem Arbeitsalltag.
  • Mindestens drei Jahre praktische Erfahrung mit IT-Sicherheit und Datenschutz sowie mit OWASP Top 10, OpenID Connect und OAuth2.
  • Mindestens zwei Jahre Erfahrung mit Monitoring und Observability, beispielsweise Grafana und Prometheus, sowie mit Logging, Tracing und der Fehleranalyse produktiver Anwendungen.
  • Erfahrung in agilen Teams, in der Aufarbeitung und Schätzung von User Stories sowie in der Zusammenarbeit mit Fachbereichen.
  • Mindestens zwei Jahre Erfahrung in der fachlichen Beratung im Umfeld der gesetzlichen Krankenversicherung, in Workshops, Präsentationen und technischer Dokumentation.
  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse auf mindestens C1-Niveau.

Zusätzliche Pluspunkte: Erfahrung mit Angular, Google Lit oder Thymeleaf, GraalVM und Native Images, Camunda, JMeter, SOAP oder Kenntnisse im BITMARCK-Umfeld, insbesondere mit BITMARCK_21c|ng.

Benefits

Tolle Leute, super Atmosphäre, dynamisches Team, agile Arbeitsweise

  • Sweet Spot zwischen Corporate-Alltag und kreativem Agenturleben: Bei uns musst du nicht zwischen hunderten Projekten gleichzeitig jonglieren, sondern bist immer nur für ein einzelnes Projekt eingeteilt.
  • Die Möglichkeit, deutschlandweit ortsunabhängig zu arbeiten, wo immer du möchtest (100 % Home Office), sowie im Rahmen der rechtlichen Vorgaben zeitweise auch im EU-Ausland.
  • Monatliches Budget für Treffen vor Ort mit deinen Kolleg, das du beliebig einsetzen kannst – für Teamtage im Coworking-Space genauso wie für gemeinsamen Lunch, Dinner oder After-Work-Drinks.
  • Regelmäßige digitale Teamabende und andere coole digitale Events.
  • Treffen vor Ort mit dem ganzen Team in unserem inoffiziellen Hub Berlin ein- bis zweimal pro Jahr.
  • Wöchentliche Learning Sessions im Team und weitere Möglichkeiten zu deiner persönlichen und beruflichen Entwicklung, etwa durch Weiterbildungen und den Erwerb von Zertifikaten.
  • Eigenständiges, flexibles Arbeiten ohne Micromanagement.

So geht es weiter

Erstes Kennenlernen
Du lernst unsere Arbeitsweise und Philosophie kennen und hast die Gelegenheit, dich vorzustellen. Wir beantworten alle deine Fragen in entspannter Atmosphäre.

Vorstellungsgespräch mit unseren Co-Foundern Laura Nielsen und Dario Zampetti
Wir lernen uns ausführlicher kennen und nehmen uns Zeit für gegenseitige Fragen.

Follow-up
Hierzu erhältst du vorab eine technische Challenge, in der du deine Herangehensweise und dein Können zeigen kannst. Deine Ergebnisse präsentierst du im Follow-up. Anschließend hast du die Möglichkeit, ein Gespräch unter vier Augen mit einem deiner zukünftigen Kolleg zu führen und in vertrauensvoller Atmosphäre all das zu fragen, was dir vielleicht noch auf der Seele brennt.

Also los geht’s! Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung.

Um es einfach zu halten, verzichten wir gerne auf ein Anschreiben. Schick uns einfach deinen Lebenslauf, auch wenn du das Gefühl hast, nicht 100 % der Anforderungen zu erfüllen.

New Monday fördert aktiv die Gleichstellung aller Beschäftigten. Wir begrüßen daher alle Bewerber, unabhängig von Geschlecht, ethnischer, kultureller und sozialer Herkunft, Alter, Religion, Weltanschauung, Behinderung sowie sexueller Identität der Person. Menschen mit Schwerbehinderung werden bei gleicher Eignung unter Berücksichtigung aller Umstände des Einzelfalls bevorzugt.

title: Technical Success Analyst - UK
description:
Marqeta is looking for a Technical Success Analyst to join our operations team and play a critical role in delivering Marqeta’s cutting-edge card issuing and payments platform to new customers. You’ll lead the technical onboarding of standardized products, support customers through implementation, and become a trusted voice both internally and externally. This role blends product expertise, customer advocacy, and a collaborative mindset to drive long-term client success and improve our implementation practices. If you’re motivated by building strong customer relationships, solving technical problems, and contributing to team growth, this could be the role for you.

PLEASE NOTE: This is a hybrid role and requires employees to be based within 35 miles of our London office. You will be expected to work on-site two days a week, on Tuesday and Thursday, with the flexibility to work remotely on the other days.

The Talent team will share more details if selected for the "Recruiter" Interview. We'd love for you to join us!

The Impact You'll Have

  • Lead Implementations: Own the configuration and deployment of Marqeta’s standardised products and services for new customers, interfacing with everyone from full stack engineers to founders/CEOs.

  • Customer Support: Serve as the technical expert guiding customers through their integration journey, especially with our APIs

  • Build Product Expertise: Develop deep knowledge of specific Marqeta products and services; create customer slide presentations,  internal runbooks and training content to scale team knowledge.

  • Advocate for Customers: Provide feedback to internal teams that reflects the customer’s voice and ensures our product evolves to meet real-world needs.

  • Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Partner with Marqeta’s Project Managers, Product Managers, Sales, and Account Management to align and execute on client goals.

Who You Are

  • 5+ years of experience in a technical customer-facing role (e.g., solutions engineering, technical onboarding, or technical support).

  • Exceptional communication skills - you can explain complex technical concepts to anyone orally and in writing. Your friends and family consider you their go-to person for understanding new technologies

  • Ability to manage projects independently and take initiative in solving problems.

  • Expert proficiency in REST APIs, Secure File Transfer Protocols (SFTP), SQL, and Datadog

  • Comfortable working across teams and building relationships with both clients and internal stakeholders.

  • A customer-first mindset; skilled at understanding customer needs and designing practical solutions.

  • Strategic thinker who can connect daily work to broader business goals and team priorities.

  • Commitment to learning and contributing to the growth of others on the team.

  • Demonstrated strong understanding of fintech (e.g. acquiring, networks, point-of-sale) and card payments background, especially on the issuing side.

  • Ability to prioritise, manage, and deliver on multiple projects simultaneously; highly motivated and able to work unsupervised against aggressive schedules.

Nice-To-Haves

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).

  • Experience working in a financial services or payments-related environment.

  • Familiarity with APIs, software integrations, or payments systems.

  • Experience with Marqeta or similar fintech platforms.

  • Ability to read technical documentation or basic code (e.g., JSON, SQL, scripting).

  • Background in training, enablement, or documentation.

  • Knowledge of customer onboarding or implementation processes in a SaaS or fintech environment.

Recruiter for this role

  • Lou Devlin - Linkedin Profile (no agencies please!)

Typical Process

  • Application Submission

  • Recruiter video call

  • Hiring manager video call

  • Virtual “Onsite” consisting of 4 x 45 min calls

  • Offer!

Compensation and Benefits

  • Premium Private Medical and Dental coverage

  • Generous time off program with additional “Floating Holiday days”

  • Retirement savings program with company contribution

  • Equity in a publicly-traded company and an Employee Stock Purchase Program

  • Monthly stipend to support our remote work model

  • Annual development stipend to support our people's growth and development

  • Family-forming benefits and up to 20 weeks of Parental Leave

  • Wellbeing programs i.e. Modern Health, HealthKick and much more…

About Marqeta

Marqeta is on a mission to change the way money moves. We’re one of the earliest enablers of embedded finance, a market opportunity sized up in the trillions. Our card issuing platform provides unprecedented flexibility and control for companies to issue cards, authorize transactions, and manage payment operations in real time. Marqeta is powering the most well known brands in the new economy (Block, Cash App, Affirm, Instacart, Doordash, Uber, Walmart, etc). You don’t need to be a Payments expert to join the Marqeta Team, let us help you with that. This is the opportunity of a lifetime to work with innovators around the world and unlock equitable financial access for all.

Marqeta’s Values

– Solve for the Customer: With a deep understanding of our customers' business and empathy for their needs, we deliver products and services that drive their success. Earning and keeping their trust guides everything we do.

– Do What's Right: Knowing businesses and livelihoods depend on us, we pursue solutions that disrupt responsibly and deliver high-quality results that our customers count on. We own our work from start to finish.

– Simplify and Innovate: We approach challenges with curiosity and take smart risks. Innovation comes from finding better, simpler ways to achieve extraordinary outcomes.

– Win as a Team: We succeed together by embracing diverse perspectives and pushing each other to raise the bar. We lead with humility and set aside hierarchy to work as a team.

– Make it Count: We drive forward with focus and agility. With a sense of urgency and purpose, we get the job done, and done right.

Equal Employment Opportunity, Accommodations and Privacy

Marqeta is an equal opportunity employer committed to an inclusive workplace that fosters belonging. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, childbirth, or related medical conditions), veteran status or uniformed service member status, age, national origin or ancestry, citizenship or immigration status, physical or mental disability, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, genetic information (including testing or characteristics) or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

Marqeta endeavors to make reasonable accommodations for applicants with disabilities. If you are an individual with a disability and require a reasonable accommodation to submit this application, complete any pre-employment testing, or otherwise participate in the employee selection process, please submit this form with your specific accommodation request.

Marqeta cares about your privacy. Personal data that is provided as part of the application and recruitment process is processed in accordance with the Applicant Privacy Notice. Additional information for California residents can be found here.

To keep our interview process fair and consistent, we ask that all candidates join video interviews with their camera on.

Notice on Use of AI in Recruitment
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools in our recruitment processing consistent with the requirements of applicable laws. For more information, review our AI notice here.

title: Content Editor
description:
Why work at Higgsfield AI?

Higgsfield AI is the fastest-scaling generative AI company in history, hitting $700M in annual revenue run rate, 30M+ users worldwide, 6M+ generations per day, and powering 390 of Fortune 500 brands.

We write a lot, and it's read by millions of people around the world. Our content team is already strong, and now we want to make it stronger. You'll be the native voice of the brand: everything our users read will go through you.

What you will work on

  • Reviewing and editing the team's copy across the blog, Help Center, changelog, Creator Hub, case studies, PR and news, newsletters, product updates, and UI text;

  • Fact-checking every piece before it ships: checking model and feature names against the product;

  • Keeping facts consistent across every surface, so the same number reads the same in the blog, Help Center, landing pages, and press releases;

  • Shaping content for AI answers: a direct answer up front, question-based headings, useful FAQs, and internal links;

  • Keeping the writing alive and human, with no traces of AI or template-speak;

  • Working on tone, rhythm and clarity, not just fixing grammar;

  • Writing your own pieces too, including editorial work like our Inside Higgsfield series;

  • Holding one consistent brand voice across everything we publish.

Your must haves

  • English as your native language;

  • A strong background in editing and writing, with a portfolio to show for it;

  • An instinct for style, tone and rhythm. You feel when a sentence works and when it doesn't;

  • The ability to explain your edits and how they make the text stronger. "It sounds better" is a start, not an answer;

  • An owner mindset: you see what could be better, and you make it happen;

  • Comfort with startup pace. We move fast, ship weekly, and the writing has to keep up.

Nice to have

  • Experience editing for a tech, SaaS or AI product;

  • Experience building or maintaining a style guide or brand voice;

  • Familiarity with the GenAI landscape and the tools creators actually use;

The deal

  • Competitive salary in USD;

  • Fully remote position;

  • Access to Higgsfield products and the AI tools we use internally;

  • Full-time position with high ownership and growth potential.

title: QA Engineer Mobile
description:
About ScholarshipOwl

ScholarshipOwl is the largest scholarship marketplace in the US, using AI to connect 14 million students who are looking for scholarships with companies that are looking for students. Our mission is to make education financing more accessible and engaging, while giving brands a way to connect with the next generation.

We’re powered by AI technology that simplifies scholarship discovery, streamlines the application process, and delivers measurable results for both students and partners. Whether it’s helping students secure funding or enabling brands to run impactful campaigns, we’re reshaping how education is funded — and discovered.

The Role

We’re looking for a highly skilled and innovative Mobile QA Engineer to lead end-to-end quality assurance, test automation, and release stability for our ScholarshipOwl Flutter mobile appand its integration with our GraphQL API. You’ll play a pivotal role in ensuring rapid, regression-free delivery across iOS, Android, and Shorebird OTA updates for millions of students.

In this role, you will champion the "new generation" of quality engineering. Beyond traditional test automation, you will leverage modern AI coding assistants (such as Cursor, Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini) as your primary force multiplier to achieve maximum test coverage at unmatched speed. Working closely with mobile and backend teams across a modern multi-service architecture, you will shift quality left, auditing Figma specs before sprint commitments, reviewing PRs, and maintaining continuous quality gates in our CI/CD pipelines.

What You’ll Do

  • End-to-End Web Automation: Build, maintain, and execute parallelized E2E smoke and regression test pipelines using Patrol integrated directly into Codemagic and GitLab CI pipeline.

  • API & Contract QA: Establish automated contract and API integration testing to validate GraphQL schema updates against mobile query requirements, guaranteeing zero breaking changes.

  • AI Integration: Deeply integrate AI tools (Cursor, Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini) into daily workflows to generate Patrol scripts directly from Figma specs, synthesize complex mock payloads, and automate log triage to double QA efficiency.

  • Shift-Left Quality Champion: Review feature specs in Figma and GraphQL schema definitions early to catch edge cases, logic gaps, and design flaws before sprint commitments and development begin. Participate actively in PR reviews.

  • System Observability & Triage: Monitor build health, Firebase Remote Config/Analytics, Sentry error logs, and GCP Cloud Run logs to triage issues across Flutter BLoC/UI state, GraphQL resolvers, and backend services, logging rich GitLab issues with dev-ready context.

  • Exploratory & Release Testing: Conduct testing across iOS Simulators, Android Emulators, physical devices, TestFlight, Google Play Console internal tracks, and Shorebird OTA hot-patches.

  • Component Testing: Utilize Flutter Storybook to conduct visual regression and component-level testing early in the release lifecycle.


Required Qualifications (Must Haves)

  • Experience Level: 3+ years of professional experience in Mobile QA Engineering / Test Automation, with at least 1+ year actively incorporating AI coding tools into daily workflows.

  • Mobile Automation Mastery: Hands-on experience with Flutter automation frameworks (Patrol, Flutter Integration Test, or strong Appium/XCUITest/Espresso skills with eager readiness to master Patrol).

  • API & Schema Verification: Proficiency in testing GraphQL APIs (Bruno, Postman, Playwright, or HTTP clients), including schema validation, headers, and JWT auth flows.

  • Mobile Ecosystem & Design: Comfort inspecting Figma files for UI specs/design tokens, using Xcode/Android Studio tools, managing Firebase Remote Config & feature flags, and navigating mobile app deployment lifecycles (Apple App Store / TestFlight, Google Play Console internal testing).

  • CI/CD & Mobile DevOps: Experience with mobile CI/CD tools (Codemagic, GitLab CI) and Git/GitLab workflows.

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience in software development / test automation.

  • Communication: Clear, concise async communication skills in written and spoken English for bug reporting, documentation, and remote collaboration.

Nice to Have

  • AI-Native Focus: Advanced proficiency loading architecture specs, GraphQL schemas, and UI design tokens into AI models to auto-generate test cases, Patrol page objects, and mock payloads.

  • Dart & Component Testing: Direct Dart / Flutter coding ability to write unit and widget tests in-repo, as well as Flutter Storybook experience.

  • OTA & Scripting: Experience with Shorebird (OTA hot patching for Flutter) or basic TypeScript / Bun experience for writing Bruno test collections or schema scripts.

  • Cloud Infrastructure & Feature Flags: Exposure to GCP (Cloud Run, Cloud Logging) and Unleash feature flag management.

  • Certifications: Certifications in Quality Engineering, Mobile Testing, or AI-Assisted Software Engineering.

Bonus Skills (The "X-Factor")

  • Cross-Platform & GraphQL Experience: Prior experience testing cross-platform Flutter applications connected to GraphQL backends in fast-paced product companies.

  • Consumer Mobile SaaS: Previous experience testing consumer mobile apps, EdTech platforms, subscription/billing systems (Stripe, in-app purchases), or user onboarding funnels.

Why Join ScholarshipOwl?

  • Mission-Driven Work: Build technology that helps students unlock education opportunities and reduce financial barriers.

  • Fully Remote: Work from anywhere in the world while collaborating with a global team.

  • High Impact & Ownership: You aren't just a cog in a machine; you own your domain and directly drive results.

  • Unlimited PTO: We value outcomes over hours worked and trust you to manage your time.

  • Computer Upgrade Budget: Up to $1,600 to invest in your ideal primary work computer.

  • Workspace Upgrade Program: Up to $800 to set up your home office.

  • Monthly Coworking Allowance: $200/month to rent desks or workspace passes whenever you want a change of scenery.

  • Owl Shine Program: Monthly employee recognition and awards celebrating extraordinary contributions.

  • Continuous Learning Culture: Dedicated support for curiosity, bold experimentation, and career growth.

  • Annual Global Off-sites: Connect with your teammates in person at exciting locations around the world.

Ready to lead and build something meaningful?

Apply now and help us shape the future of AI-powered education.

title: Senior Fullstack Entwickler PHP/Laravel (m/w/d) - Remote, 4-Tage-Woche
description:
Intro

Du möchtest an einer Legal-Tech-Anwendung arbeiten, die für E-Commerce-Unternehmen wie eine digitale Rechtsabteilung funktioniert? Du denkst Systeme vom Datenmodell bis zur Oberfläche, konzipierst gern technische Lösungen und übernimmst Verantwortung dafür, dass sie am Ende auch so umgesetzt werden? Dann bist du als Senior Fullstack-Entwickler (m/w/d) / Senior Webentwickler PHP/Laravel (m/w/d) beim Händlerbund genau richtig!

Bei uns entwickelst du an einer Plattform, die rechtliche Prozesse digital abbildet und automatisiert. Von der Erstellung rechtlicher Inhalte über Vertrags- und Prüfprozesse bis hin zu Datenschutz- und Sicherheitsfragen. Dazu gehören Schnittstellen und Plugins, über die unsere Inhalte in die Shopsysteme unserer Mitglieder gelangen, sowie Integrationen mit Partnersystemen. Ziel ist es, komplexe rechtliche Anforderungen in verlässliche, verständliche und effiziente digitale Workflows zu überführen.

In dieser Rolle übernimmst du die technische Leitung von Projekten, die wir in kleinen Projektteams umsetzen: Du konzipierst Lösungen, verantwortest die Umsetzung, leitest andere Entwickler im Projekt an und hältst alle Beteiligten über den Stand auf dem Laufenden. Kleinere Projekte setzt du eigenständig komplett um, bei größeren arbeitest du im Team mit Laravel und Livewire im Stack.


Deine Aufgaben

  • Technische Konzeption: Analyse von Anforderungen, Entwurf der Lösungsarchitektur, Festlegung von Datenmodellen und Schnittstellen sowie Einschätzung von Aufwänden für Features und Projekte.

  • Ownership für die Umsetzung: Verantwortung dafür, dass ein Projekt von der Konzeption bis zum Go-live ankommt. Aufgaben schneiden und priorisieren, Fortschritt im Blick behalten, technische Entscheidungen treffen und Blocker aus dem Weg räumen.

  • Anleitung & Wissenstransfer: Fachliche Führung weiterer Entwickler im Projekt durch klare technische Vorgaben, Pairing und Code Reviews im Backend wie im Frontend. Wissen über Architektur und Entscheidungen landet im Team und in der Dokumentation, nicht nur bei dir.

  • Reporting: Regelmäßige, verständliche Berichte zu Stand, Risiken und nächsten Schritten an Team Lead, Product Owner und Stakeholder.

  • Fullstack-Entwicklung: Umsetzung mit Laravel, Livewire, Alpine.js, Flux UI und Tailwind CSS. Kleinere Projekte eigenständig von Anfang bis Ende, größere im Projektteam.

  • Partneranbindungen & Integrationen: Lösungsevaluierung, Umsetzung und Dokumentation von Schnittstellen zu Partner- und Drittsystemen.

  • Architektur & Technologie-Evaluation: Mitgestaltung von Architektur, Entwicklungsstandards und Tooling; Evaluation neuer Technologien, Frameworks und KI-Einsatzmöglichkeiten im Hinblick auf ihren konkreten Nutzen für Produkt und Team.


Dein Profil

Technisch

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung mit PHP & Laravel: Entwicklung von Webanwendungen über den gesamten Stack, im Frontend idealerweise mit Livewire, Alpine.js, Flux UI und Tailwind CSS.

  • Konzeption & technische Leitung: Erfahrung darin, technische Konzepte zu erarbeiten und deren Umsetzung zu verantworten, allein oder als technische Leitung eines Projektteams.

  • Code Reviews über den gesamten Stack: Praxis im Review von Backend- und Frontend-Code und die Fähigkeit, Feedback so zu geben, dass andere daran wachsen.

  • Testerfahrung: Sicherer Umgang mit PHPUnit oder Pest und Erfahrung mit Teststrategien in größeren Codebasen. Tests sind für dich Teil der Umsetzung, nicht Nacharbeit.

  • Datenbanken & APIs: Sicherer Umgang mit relationalen Datenbanken, Datenmodellierung und API-Design.

  • Agile Teamarbeit: Erfahrung in agilen Teams, idealerweise mit Scrum, inklusive enger Zusammenarbeit und kontinuierlichem Austausch.


Nice to Have, aber kein Muss

  • DevOps-Erfahrung: Cloud-Systeme, PaaS-Plattformen, Container, CI/CD oder Linux-Serveradministration (z.B. DigitalOcean und Laravel Cloud)

  • Erfahrung mit Shopsystemen und der Entwicklung von Plugins oder Apps dafür (z.B. Shopify oder JTL)

  • Gespür für UX und Erfahrung in der Gestaltung benutzerfreundlicher Oberflächen

  • Erfahrung mit Event-basierten Architekturen, Queues oder asynchronen Verarbeitungsprozessen

  • Erfahrung mit der Integration von LLM-APIs in Produktfeatures (Prompting, Evaluierung, Guardrails)


Persönlich

  • Ownership: Du fühlst dich für das Ergebnis eines Projekts verantwortlich. Von der ersten Skizze bis zum Go-live und darüber hinaus und nicht nur für deine eigenen Tickets.

  • Systemisches Denken: Du siehst die Auswirkungen von Änderungen über Komponenten- und Teamgrenzen hinweg.

  • Strukturierte Kommunikation: Du bereitest den Stand eines Projekts für technische und nicht-technische Beteiligte verständlich auf, auch dann, wenn etwas nicht nach Plan läuft.

  • Pragmatismus: Du findest die Balance zwischen sauberer Lösung und pragmatischem Fortschritt.

  • Wissenstransfer: Du hast Freude daran, Wissen weiterzugeben und andere im Team besser zu machen, bspw. in Reviews, Pairings und Dokumentation.

  • KI als Werkzeug: Du nutzt KI-Tools im Entwicklungsalltag selbstverständlich und beurteilst nüchtern, wo sie im Produkt echten Nutzen bringen und wo nicht.


Warum wir?

Code. Chill. Repeat.

  • 4 Tage Code – 3 Tage du selbst: Bei uns ist die 4-Tage-Woche Standard. Kein Gimmick, sondern Realität. Du arbeitest remote oder im Leipziger Büro – so, wie du am besten performst. Flexzeiten, kein Micromanagement, volle Eigenverantwortung. Und ja: unbefristet von Anfang an.

  • Dein Stack, dein Style: Wir stehen auf smarte Lösungen, sauberen Code und Menschen, die mitdenken. Du willst mitentscheiden, ausprobieren und nicht nur Tickets abarbeiten? Here you go. Plus: Mentoring, Weiterbildung nach Bedarf und Raum für echte Weiterentwicklung.

  • Remote first, Team always: Trotz Remote bleibt das Teamgefühl. Wir feiern Releases, grillen im Sommer und stoßen auf tolle Ideen an. Dein Bürohund ist bei uns genauso willkommen wie dein Lieblingseditor.

  • Professionalität: echte Qualität statt Show-off. Wir leben agile Entwicklung mit klaren Iterationen und direktem Feedback. Du arbeitest mit modernen, professionellen Tools, mit klaren Rollen und Verantwortlichkeiten – du weißt genau, was dein Job ist und hast die Freiheit, ihn so zu machen, wie es richtig ist. Sauberer Code, smarte Entscheidungen und ein Team, das zusammenarbeitet. Professionalität heißt hier: Du kannst dich auf das konzentrieren, was du am besten kannst – entwickeln.

  • Snacks, Swag & Softdrinks: Obst, Müsli, Kaffee, Wasser – alles for free. Kein Dresscode. Komm, wie du bist. Hauptsache du fühlst dich wohl.

  • Perks, die was bringen: Kita-Zuschuss, Unterstützung bei der Altersvorsorge, Leipziger Jobticket oder sportliche Angebote für deinen Ausgleich – vom Homegym bis zum Fitnessstudio für Kopf und Körper.


Dein Weg zu uns
